chinese.text: 奴才！我已经把我这条命打过赌，我宁可孤注一掷，决个胜负。我以为战场上共有六个里士满呢；今天已斩杀了五个，却没有杀死他。——一匹马！一匹马！我的王位换一匹马！

groups.rationale: Whole Richard speech on gambling his life and demanding a horse. Exclude final inline exit and the following battle/entrance direction 01253.

chinese.text: 现在我们严冬般的宿怨已给这颗约克的红日照耀成为融融的夏景；那笼罩着我们王室的片片愁云全都埋进了海洋深处。现在我们的额前已经戴上胜利的花圈；我们已把战场上折损的枪矛高挂起来留作纪念；当初的尖厉的角鸣已变为欢庆之音；杀气腾腾的进军步伐一转而为轻歌妙舞。那面目狰狞的战神也不再横眉怒目；如今他不想再跨上征马去威吓敌人们战栗的心魄，却只顾在贵妇们的内室里伴随着春情逸荡的琵琶声轻盈地舞蹈。可是我呢，天生我一副畸形陋相，不适于调情弄爱，也无从对着含情的明镜去讨取宠幸；我比不上爱神的风采，怎能凭空在嫋娜的仙姑面前昂首阔步；我既被卸除了一切匀称的身段模样，欺人的造物者又骗去了我的仪容，使得我残缺不全，不等我生长成形，便把我抛进这喘息的人间，加上我如此跛跛踬踬，满叫人看不入眼，甚至路旁的狗儿见我停下，也要狂吠几声；说实话，我在这软绵绵的歌舞升平的年代，却找不到半点赏心乐事以消磨岁月，无非背着阳光窥看自己的阴影，口中念念有词，埋怨我这废体残形。因此，我既无法由我的春心奔放，趁着韶光洋溢卖弄风情，就只好打定主意以歹徒自许，专事仇视眼前的闲情逸致了。我这里已设下圈套，搬弄些是非，用尽醉酒诳言、毁谤、梦呓，唆使我三哥克莱伦斯和大哥皇上之间结下生死仇恨：为的是有人传说爱德华的继承人之中有个G字起头的要弑君篡位
，只消爱德华的率直天真比得上我的机敏阴毒，管叫他今天就把克莱伦斯囚进大牢。且埋藏起我的这番心念，克莱伦斯来了。
三哥，您好，阁下身边带有武装守卫是何道理哪？

chinese.text: 国王陛下，为了照顾我身子安全，指派了守卫，要送我进伦敦塔。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是什么缘由呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为了我名叫乔治。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵哟！我的王公，这哪是你的过错呢；若是为了这个缘故，他就该定你教父的罪。呵，陛下他也许打算送你进塔去重新命名吧。当真为的什么，克莱伦斯，你能告诉我吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 当然，理查，只要我知道；可是我实在弄不清；不过，据我所知，他听信了一些痴人说梦的预言；他从儿童识字本里拈出一个G字来，说什么巫人曾经告诉他这个G字会篡夺他的王位；而我的名字乔治恰是G字起头，于是他就一心认定我就是篡位的人。据说，竟是这一类的无稽之谈嗾使了皇上今天定下我的罪名。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对呀，正是如此，因为男子受了女人的统治：不是皇上把你关进伦敦塔的；原来是他的妻后，葛雷夫人，在旁指使他，造成了这个恐怖局面。难道不就是她和她的尊兄伍德维尔那位大人，彼此共谋，海司丁斯才被送进塔牢，直到今天才获释吗？我们都不很安全哪，克莱伦斯；都不很安全。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 天哪，我看除了外戚们，谁的安全也没有保障了，除非是那些在皇上和休亚夫人之间穿梭不停地星夜奔忙的传信人。你可曾听说海司丁斯为了重获自由，是如何向她卑躬屈节的吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 硬把她当神明一样膜拜，低声诉苦，这位御前大臣才讨回了自由。告诉你吧，我看我们也只有这一条路；要想赢得圣恩，就得听她使唤，穿上她门下仆从的制服给她效劳。那窄心眼儿的老寡妇和休亚自己自从受到我们王兄的册封以来，已一跃而为朝廷的显要人物了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我请求两位王公宽恕；国王陛下有命，所有的人，不论职位高低，一概不准同你这位哥哥交谈。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 当真；对不起，勃莱肯伯雷，我们的谈话你尽可任意倾听。我们没有讲犯上的话，老兄。我们说国王贤明，还说他那位高贵的王后年事已高，心地宽厚，并且美貌出众；我们说休亚夫人有一双俊秀的脚，樱桃小口，妩媚的眼，十分悦耳的声调；也还说到外戚们都封为权贵了。你怎么说，爵爷？你能否认这些事吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 关于这些，王爷，不干我任何事。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你同休亚夫人干过好事？我说，老兄，同她干好事，除一人而外，最好独守秘密。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么一个人，王爷？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她的夫君，坏蛋，你想出卖我吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我请求阁下原谅；同时还求您莫再同这位王公交谈。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们知道你职责在身，勃莱肯伯雷，我们一定从命。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们原是主后的卑贱的奴仆，只好从命。三哥，再会吧，我就去见国王；不管什么事，只要你吩咐我去办，即使把那寡妇王后认做亲姊姊也可以，只消能为你换取自由。然而，这种兄弟阋于墙的奇耻大辱，你真不知道我心头是一种什么滋味呵。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我相信这个处境确是你我所难于接受的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好吧，你的监禁决不会太久，我一定来救你，不然的话，我就见不得人啦
。目前你还要忍耐才是。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我一定忍耐，再会。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去吧，走上你那万劫不复的路吧，单纯的克莱伦斯！我是多么爱你，恨不得马上把你的灵魂送归天国，单看上天是否有意收下我这份礼物。这是谁来了？是才放出监牢的海司丁斯吧！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿天赐您福分，好心肠的大人！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿您也同得天福，御前大人！欢迎您重见天日。大臣，您是怎样熬过那狱中的日子的呀？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 忍耐，高贵的大人，狱中人还有什么办法？我不得不留着这条命，好向陷害我的人表示谢意。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不错，不错；克莱伦斯也是一样；原来你的仇人就是他的，他们压倒了你，也压倒了他。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可叹鹫鹰禁闭了起来，而鸢鹗之类反可以悠然自得。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 外边有什么消息吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 外边的任何消息都没有里边的凶恶；国王病重、虚弱、忧闷寡欢，御医们很为他焦急。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 圣保罗在上，这个消息的确不妙。呵，他早就饮食不正常，过分地亏损了他的身体，叫人想起就要感伤不已。那么，他是睡倒在床上了吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 请先走一步，我随后就来。
我希望他活不了；然而他也决不可马上就死，且等乔治兼程归了天再说。我要进宫去，去加深他对克莱伦斯的仇恨，毁谤不够，再添些雄辞力辩；只要我心底的计谋得逞，克莱伦斯别想再多活一天：这件事办妥了，上帝就好照顾爱德华王，那时这世界便由我来独自纵横了！那样，我好娶过华列克的幼女
。我虽杀了她的丈夫和父亲，这有何相干，要补偿这娘儿的损失莫过于由我来当她的夫君兼父亲：这才是我的主意；倒不是为了什么爱，为的却是另一桩私地里的打算，只有娶到了她才能如愿。可是这些话我其实说得太早一点：克莱伦斯还在人世；爱德华还占着宝座；病而未死：且等他们都去了再打我的算盘不迟。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 役吏们簇拥亨利六世棺具上，安夫人送殡致哀。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 放下来，放下你们的光荣负担，假如棺木中也能包藏光荣的话，我好趁此为善良的兰开斯特的夭亡而一尽哀仪。可怜的主君呀，你的圣体已经冰凉！呀，兰开斯特王室的余灰残烬！你这副皇族血统的枯骨，滴血都已流尽！愿国法容许我呼唤你的精灵，请听我可怜的安为你哀号，我就是你遇了害的儿子爱德华的妻子，同一只毒手杀害了你父子二人！看哪，你身上的伤口破裂，英灵从这些裂缝中穿出，我一个弱女的热泪填敷不了你的满身创痛。呵！可诅咒的刽子手呀，是他戳开了你这些伤孔！可诅咒的狼心狗肺呀，是他干出了如此狠心的事！可诅咒的毒血儿呀，是他放干了你的圣血！愿这个万恶的祸首不得善终，他害死了你，带给我们无穷的灾难！愿他所遭受的毁灭比那些蛇、虺、蛛、蟾，或世上任何爬行毒虫所应得的结果更加残酷！愿他所生下的孩子是个流产怪物，不让它足月便仓促下地！愿他生就一副丑陋反常的狰狞面目，使那期待着的母亲一见就心生恐惧！愿这个人妖继承他自己的逆运！愿他所娶的妻房也因夫亡而受苦，比我因我夫和你两人的遇难所受的苦还要多！好吧，现在请你们将这神圣的负担从圣保罗教堂送往丘邨安葬吧；可是你们如果很累，也不妨多作休息，好让我向故君亨利尽哀。（役吏们重抬棺具前进。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 停一下，你们抬棺具的人，放下来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是哪个魔术家唤出这个恶鬼来阻挡人间忠爱的大事呀？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 混账的家伙，放下那棺具来；否则，凭圣保罗在此，你休想活命。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 大人，请退后一步，让棺柩通过。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 无礼的狗东西！我发号令，你就得站住。你若举起戈戟高过我的胸膛，让圣保罗作证，我要把你踢倒脚下，踩上你的身子，奴才，你好大胆。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么啦！你们发抖了？都害怕吗？呵，难怪，难怪，你们都是人，人的眼哪能经得起看魔鬼出现呢。滚开！你是地狱中的恶魔王，你的魔力至多不过残害了他的肉身，他的灵魂却不归你所有。快滚开去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可爱的圣女，仁恕要紧，莫这样恶言恶语。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 恶魔，上天不容，走开些，莫来寻麻烦；你已经把快乐世界变成了地狱，使人间充满了怒咒痛号的惨声。你如果愿意欣赏你残害忠良的劣迹，就请一看你自己屠刀杀人的这具模型。呵，看哪！大家来看故君亨利的创痕，看它们凝口又裂开了，鲜血又喷流了。你还有什么脸哪，你这个臭不可闻的残废，仅仅因为你站前一步，他那原已冷瘪的血管又鲜血奔流：是你的所作所为，反人性，反天意，引发了这股逆潮。呵，造物主呀！你创造了他的血，为他复仇；呵，大地呀！你吮吸了他的血，为他伸冤；若非天公以雷电击杀这个杀人犯，就让大地裂开，将他活生生吞进去，因为就是他那只接受地狱指挥的魔手闯下了这场惨祸，而贤君的滴滴热血已被地面吞咽尽了！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 夫人，你全不懂得仁恕之道，讲仁恕就要以善报恶，以德报怨。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 坏蛋，你既不懂天理，也不顾人情！任何一只猛兽也还有点恻隐之心。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我却完全没有，所以不是一只兽。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！妙呀，魔鬼也会说句真话。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 更妙的是，天使也会这样发怒。圣洁无瑕的女界楷模，望你容许我从这些假设虚构的罪名中，来旁推侧引，以便洗雪我自身。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 支离糜烂的男界毒疣，你该让我从这些彰明较著的败迹中，来旁推侧引，以便咒骂你奴才。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你美色无限，真叫人夸也夸不完，还求你包容，给我充分时日来向你表白一番。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你丑恶万分，真叫人难以设想，凭你巧辩，也无从取信于人，除非你自缢身死。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我既如此无望，就只好自首请罪了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你既不顾一切，玩忽人命，正该截断生路，以一死为报，才能赢得人们的饶恕。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 姑且说我并未杀他们。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 倒不如说他们没有被杀。可是他们确已死了，恶魔，凶手就是你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我没有杀你的夫君。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那末他就还在人间啰。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不，他确已死去；是爱德华下的手。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这是从你那臭嘴里撒出来的谎言。玛格莱特王后亲眼看见你的利刃淋着他的血，杀气腾腾；你还拿起那凶器刺向她的胸膛，幸亏你两个哥哥把那刀头拨开了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那是她的毁谤激动了我，她硬把我哥哥们的罪名套上了我的头。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是你自己的豺狼之心激动了你，你屠杀成性，心中别无善念。你究竟杀了这位君王没有？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我向你认罪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你这才向我供认了，刺猬？好，我愿上帝应我所求，因你的罪孽而把你贬入地狱！呵！他是个何等温良而有德行的人呀。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 天国收容了他，他正好为天帝效忠。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他已进天国，你却莫想进去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他该感谢我，是我帮了他一手；因为他去天上比留在人间更加自在些。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可是你除了地狱就无处容身。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 也还有个去处，只要你肯听我讲出来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 一个幽狱地牢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的闺房卧室。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不管你哪儿栖身，你休想安宁！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 的确我不会安宁，夫人，除非我能一旦在你身旁栖憩。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 天知道。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我知道。可是，温良的安夫人，为了停止这场唇舌的交锋，而改用一种比较缓和的方式，我请问，我们王室的亨利呀，爱德华呀，都一个个夭亡，那首先惹起这祸端的人难道就不该和那动刀下手的人一并论罪吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 祸根就是你，而干出这样滔天罪行的也是你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 原是你的天姿国色惹起了这一切；你的姿色不断在我睡梦中萦绕，直叫我顾不得天下生灵，只是一心想在你的酥胸边取得一刻温暖。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 早知如此，我告诉你，凶犯，我一定亲手抓破我的红颜。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我怎能漠视美容香腮受到摧残；有我在身边就不会容许你加以毁损：正如太阳照耀大地，鼓舞世人，你的美色就是我的白昼和生命。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 让黑夜掩盖你的白昼，死亡吞没你的生命！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 莫诅咒你自身，你正是白昼，又是生命，可人儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 但愿能这样，正好报你的仇。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 要在爱你的人身上报仇，好一场离奇古怪的争执。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为了在杀害我夫君的人身上雪恨复仇，正是一番公允合理的争论。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 夫人，那使你丧失夫君的人为的就是要帮你另配一个更好的夫君。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 比他还好的人，世上已经找不到了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这个人却在人间，他爱你更为深厚。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 讲出他的姓名来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 普兰塔琪纳特

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 正是他。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 和他同名，品质却在他之上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这个人在哪儿？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 在这儿。（她啐他）你为什么唾我？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对付你，我巴不得能喷出毒液来！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这样甜蜜的嘴里哪儿喷得出毒液。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哪儿还有比你更臭更烂的毒蛤蟆。我见不得你！你会使我双目都遭殃。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 甜蜜的夫人，是你的媚眼殃及了我的官能。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 但愿我目光如蛇怪，好致你死命！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这样才好，好让我死得痛快；无奈你秋波一转竟害得我活不成，死不了。你那双迷魂的眼睛叫我一见，就不由得不泪珠盈盈，像孩童般顾不得人们的耻笑；我的眼里何曾流过什么真情的泪；当黑脸的克列福挥动长刀指向弱小的鲁特兰，逼得他哀号悲鸣，这时间我父约克和哥哥爱德华都忍不住哭泣起来，而我却没有流泪；再说，当你那英勇的父亲像一个孩童般追述着我父亲如何惨遭杀害，他曾多次泣不成声，闻者都不禁泪流满颊，好比树身淋着雨水一样：在那个悲哀的时日，我还是虎视眈眈，不屑抛出一滴弱泪；当年那些伤心事都打不动我的心，可是，今天我却为你的美色热泪盈眶。我从不向友人求情，向敌人讨饶；我的舌头学不会一句甜蜜话；可是今天却是你的红颜为我付出了讼费，逼得我压住傲气而向你苦苦申诉。（她向他横眉怒目，表示轻蔑）何必那样噘起轻慢的朱唇呢，夫人，天生你可亲吻的香腮，不是给你做侮蔑之用的。如果你还是满心仇恨，不肯留情，那末我这里有一把尖刀借给你；单看你是否想把它藏进我这赤诚的胸膛，解脱我这向你膜拜的心魂，我现在敞开来由你狠狠地一戳，我双膝跪地恳求你恩赐，了结我这条生命。（打开胸膛；她持刀欲砍）快呀，别住手；是我杀了亨利王；也还是你的美貌引起我来。莫停住，快下手；也是我刺死了年轻的爱德华；又还是你的天姿鼓舞了我。（她又作砍势，但立即松手，刀落地）拾起那把刀来，不然就搀我起来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 站起来，假殷勤。我虽巴不得你死，倒不想做你的刽子手。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那末吩咐我自杀，我一定照办。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我已经讲过了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那是你在盛怒之下说的；再说一遍，只消你金口一开，我这只手，为了爱你曾经杀过你的旧欢，现在还是为了爱你，可以再杀一个爱得你更加真切的情郎。这样，新欢旧爱先后被杀，而你却都是从犯。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我倒很想看看你这颗心。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的心就挂在我的嘴唇边。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我怕你竟是心口全非。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那世上就没有一个真心人了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好啦，好啦，把你的刀收起来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那末就算是和解了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这还得等着瞧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 但是我可否就在希望中求生呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 人人都靠希望生存，我想。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 答应我戴上这只戒指。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 受礼并非受聘。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 看，这戒指不大不小，恰巧戴上你的手指，正像你的胸腔紧紧围住我这颗可怜的心一样；戒指和心都归你有，都拿去使用吧。你如果还肯答应你的忠仆一件事的话，那就是你最后肯定了我一生的幸福了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么事？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿你允许我来办理这场丧仪，我是个最应该致悼尽哀的人，你不妨立刻移驾到克洛斯比宫中；且等我去丘邨寺把这位高贵的君王安葬入土，虔心诚意在坟前洒下我忏悔的热泪，然后，我就赶紧来向你致候。这里有各种说不清的原因，但愿你能应允我这个请求。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我很愿意；我能看见你这样深悔前非，心里也十分喜悦。特莱塞尔和勃克雷，你两人跟我同走吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 向我道别一声哪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 未免有些过分；不过你既教了我如何待你和善，不妨就假想我已道别过了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 各位弟兄们，抬起棺具来吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去丘邨吗，尊贵的大人？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不，去僧院；先去等着我来。

哪有一个女子是这样让人求爱的？哪有一个女子是这样求到手的？我要娶了她；可是也不要长期留下她来。什么！我这个杀死了她丈夫和他父王的人，要在她极度悲愤之余娶过她来；她的咒骂还在嘴边，眼眶里还含着泪，她那心头之恨还有这斑斑血痕做实证；上帝、她的良心和我的这些缺陷都在控诉我，叫我简直站不住脚跟，而我呢，只凭包藏的祸心和满面的春风，仍要把她弄到手，哪怕她那边千岩万壑，而我却空无所有！哈！难道她已经把那位勇敢的王子抛到脑后去了吗？仅仅三个月之前在图克斯伯雷，是我一怒而杀了她的夫君爱德华。广阔的天地间再也找不出一个比他更为和善可亲的人，繁茂的自然界培育了他那样的一个人才，年轻、无畏、聪明，并且确实高贵无比，而我竟折损了这位好王子的青春，使她早年丧偶，独守空房，难道她就此降低眼界看中了我吗？我的所有禀赋怎抵得上半个爱德华呢？我这样一拐一瘸，这样残缺其形？我的公爵爵位又哪儿值得半分一毫，显然我在这一向一直把自己看错了。天知道，她却是另眼相看，把我抬得很高，虽然我还有些莫名其妙。我只有花费一笔钱，置一面衣镜，雇一批缝衣匠，收养他一二十个，让他们推究一下时装，为我打扮起来。我既碰上了好运，不妨就付出一些代价维持个场面。可是我还得去安葬这家伙，然后哭丧着脸去找我的爱。照耀着吧，太阳，等我买到了镜子，好让我在镜前端详我的影儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 忍耐些，夫人，我们的王上不久一定会恢复他的健康的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 您如果向坏处去想，反而会叫他病体恶化，所以千万看老天面上安下心来，讲几句高兴的话，安慰王上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 万一他归了天，我便如何是好？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 至多就是丧失了这样一位君王。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 正是丧失这样一位君王要带来一切灾难呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 天赐你一位好太子，国王亡故之后他就是你的慰藉。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呀，他还年轻；在他成年之前要受理查·葛罗斯特的保护，而他对我没有好感，对你们也同样没有好感。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他担任护国公是已经决定了吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 已经议定了，还没有最后决定。一旦王上有故，这就是难免的了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 勃金汉和斯丹莱两位大人来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 王后，愿您今天圣躬安好！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿上天使娘娘安乐如常！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的好大人斯丹莱，我怕里士满伯爵夫人
，未见得会同意祝福我吧。可是，她虽则是你的夫人，斯丹莱，恐怕她对我并无好感，尽管如此，好大人，你放心，我倒不会因为见她高傲而怀恨于你的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我要求您不可轻信那班诬告捏造的人，他们居心叵测，无事生非；万一他们言之有据，也还望您宽恕，我看她的缺点其实是刚愎自用，并非生性险毒。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你今天见到王上没有，斯丹莱大人？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 勃金汉公爵和我两人是才见过王上来的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他的病体有康复的可能吗，两位大人？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 王后，很有希望；陛下谈得很高兴。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿上帝赐他健康！你们和他谈过话？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的，王后：他表示愿意在葛罗斯特同您兄弟之间斡旋和解，也想消除他们同御前大臣之间的隔阂；并且已经召他们来觐见了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 但愿百事顺心！只怕办不到。我担心我们的福分已经到顶了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他们很对不起我，我决不能容忍下去。是谁在王上面前抱怨叫苦，竟说我为人凶狠，对他们没有好感？圣保罗为证，谁在他耳朵边挑唆，无中生有，谁就是对王上不忠。只是为了我不会谄媚或假作殷勤，不会在人前装笑脸，或花言巧语骗人，或者学着法国人那样点头点脑，像猴儿般假装讲礼，于是把我当敌人看待，怀疑我心狠。丑人就该死吗？就一定存心害人吗？一副单纯的真实心肠就该受到凌辱，就该让狡猾欺诈的家伙占尽上风吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们都在此，您所指的是谁哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 就指你，你毫无心肝，全不顾情面。我什么时候害了你的？什么事做得对不起你？或对你？对你？或你们中间任何一个？你们都该遭天谴！皇帝陛下——愿上帝庇佑他，不让你们的恶意得逞！——你们竟不让他一刻安息，偏要去烦他的心，厚着脸儿去向他诉苦诬告。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 葛罗斯特贤弟，你想错了。王上自有他自己的圣意宏旨，并没有谁请求过他，或从中挑拨；可能你内心的仇恨在不知不觉中见诸你的行动，在反对我的孩子、兄弟和我本人，因而他起意召见，以便亲自明了一下你那敌意的根由何在，好设法解除。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我说不出；反正世风日下，老鹰不敢栖息的地方，却有鸥鹪在掠夺。个个坏蛋都得意，多少正经人被降为奴才。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好了，好了，我们懂得你的用意所在了，葛罗斯特弟弟，你不乐意我们这些人晋升。愿上帝照看我们永远不需要依靠你！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可是，上帝倒让我们依靠着你们呢：我三哥是你们玩了手段而下狱的，我自己受辱，显贵被侮慢；而那些一文不值的家伙，反而不消两天工夫就一个个升官发财，蒸蒸日上了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我本来乐天安命，自蒙圣恩提拔，赐我高位，我寝食难安，愿圣上作证，我从未挑唆陛下陷害克莱伦斯公爵，却总是真心诚意为他恳求。主公，你如此凭空捏造，恶意猜忌，实在是欺人太甚。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你甚至也可以否认最近海司丁斯大人入狱的事有你的一份。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她的确可以，大人；因为——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她的确可以，利佛斯大人！嘿，谁不知道？她可以做的，大人，的确还不只是否认这件事。她还可以协助你官运亨通，而一转眼又可以否认她伸过一只手，说什么全靠你自己才能过人。她哪件事不可以做？她的确可以——对了，的确她可以——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么，的确她可以什么？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么，的确她可以什么！可以嫁国王，一个未婚的青年，漂亮的小伙子。老实说，你的祖母还没有嫁得这样称心呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 葛罗斯特公爵，我忍无可忍了，你这种冷嘲毒骂怎叫我受得住；天哪，我一定要去禀告王上，我已经忍够了这类粗鲁的口吻。要我如此受嘲弄，听恶声，来换取一个王后的尊号，倒不如出身乡野，当个佣妇。我如今当这个英吉利王后实在很少滋味。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我祈求上帝把你那很少减为更少！你的荣誉、排场、宝座原来都是我的权分。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么！你要拿禀告国王来吓住我不成？去告他好了，莫留情；请看吧，我所讲过的话在国王面前我一定承担下来。我不怕关进伦敦塔。是讲话的时候了；我的劳绩差不多都已被人忘记了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 滚呵，魔鬼！我才记得清楚呢：你在伦敦塔里杀了我丈夫亨利，在图克斯伯雷你又杀了我儿子爱德华。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 还在你丈夫和你两人称王道后以前，为了他的丰功伟绩我尽过汗马之劳，他的劲敌我为他铲除干净，他的友人我为他酬劳嘉奖；我流了自己的血去尊崇他的血。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对了，还有比他和你更尊贵的血呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 在那个时期你和你前夫葛雷却在为兰开斯特树党作乱；利佛斯你也在内。你前夫岂不是在玛格莱特战役中在圣奥尔本被杀的吗？你们如果健忘，就让我提醒你们，你们过去是怎样，如今又怎样；还有，我过去怎样，如今我又怎样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你一向是个杀人犯，如今还是一样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可怜的克莱伦斯曾经背弃了他的丈人华列克，哦，还发了伪誓——愿耶稣宽恕他！——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿上帝惩罚他！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为了替爱德华争取王冠而战；可怜的王公，他所换得的酬偿乃是囚禁。愿上帝赐我一副爱德华那样的铁石心肠；否则就该让他学我一样以慈悲为怀。我太稚气了，傻得不合时宜。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你这个恶魔，你还是辞了人间，蒙着脸钻进地狱去吧，那儿才是你的老家。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 葛罗斯特大人，当年世事动荡，我们无非追随一个合法的国王，认他为主君，您今天却指责我们为叛乱之人；其实您如果一旦做了君王，我们还该效忠于您哪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如果我做了君王！我宁可做个小贩。我根本没有这个念头。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 假如你当了我们的国王，大人，你也享受不了多少快乐，正像我今天当了王后，你该能设想我所享受的快乐就很有限。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 王后所享受的快乐确实有限；我就是一国之后，而我就找不到丝毫乐趣。我再也忍不住了。
听我讲，你们这班嚣嚷不已的海盗们，你们洗劫了我，又相互争吵起来！你们哪一个见了我不吓得发抖呀？不是吗？在我当王后的时候，你们岂不是低首臣服的吗？而一旦我被废黜了，你们难道不是像叛徒一样在我面前惊惶失措吗？呀！你这个贵胄的败类，你休想躲避过去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 满脸皱纹的丑巫婆，你想在我面前干什么？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 无非把你所干的坏事重述一遍；等我讲完了才放你过去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 驱逐出境、违则处死的不就是你吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 有过这件事；不过流放的日子我受不了，倒不如居留而死。你欠下我一夫一子；还夺去我一个王国；你们都背叛了我。我今天的苦难应由你们承担，你们所篡夺去的荣华都应归我所有。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 当初我高贵的先君对你赌过咒，因为你将纸冠戴上他英勇的头额，你那满口恶言引出他滔滔的泪水；这时你递给他破布拭泪，而布上却浸透了俊秀的鲁特兰的无辜鲜血；我先君一时气愤难遏，发出诅咒，咒语降临你身；现在天公向你讨回血债，不能埋怨我们。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 天心公正，无辜者的冤仇得到了伸雪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！杀死稚子真是罪大恶极的事，是一种闻所未闻、凶残无比的行为。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 暴行的消息传来，暴君也不免要悲泣了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 谁都能预料到恶人终归有恶报。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 诺森伯兰伯爵目睹惨景也落了眼泪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嘿！在我未到之前，你们岂不都在狺狺地要拼个你死我活吗？现在却迁怒到我身上来了？难道约克的恶咒竟赢得了天听，因而亨利丧命，爱德华夭折，国祚中断，我自己衔哀出奔，这一切都为了那个无聊的乳臭小子吗？难道诅咒竟能穿破云层而通达天庭吗？果真如此，就让重云四散，听我连声恶咒吧！我诅咒你们的君王虽不死于疆场，也将因饮食无度而逝，为的是他杀了我王而称君道帝！我子爱德华过去是太子，你子爱德华今天被立为太子，我咒他同样夭亡，死于非命！你是王后，而我也一度是王后，看你荣华享尽，到最后，也和我一样同遭困厄！我咒你苟延残喘，为了儿女夭折而终日以泪洗面！今天我见你荣占我位，愿你来日也眼见旁人僭替你位！我咒你老死未临而安乐早逝；历尽你迟迟的辛酸岁月，到头来只落得你亡嗣亡夫亡江山！利佛斯与道塞特，还有海司丁斯，——当时我儿被刺，血染白刃，你们都袖手旁观，无动于衷。我祈求上帝不让你们任何人得享天年，愿你们突遭凶变，断送生命。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可恶的老巫婆，停止你的妖言！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 放过你吗？站住，狗东西，听我说来。我愿凶灾降临你身，但天上如果还积存更多的噩运，呀，我愿天公暂作保留，且等你一旦恶贯满盈，再大发神威，猛击你这个扰乱人世的祸首！愿你的一点天良像蠹虫般永远啮蚀着你的心魂！愿你此生将契友认作仇人，把奸贼当作亲人！让你那双杀人的眼睛终宵不得合拢，除非噩梦苦扰你的心神，这时刻所有地狱中的牛鬼蛇神全都出动，吓得你心惊胆裂！你是一条打了鬼印、流产下来的掘土猪！你在出胎时早已注定要永远做天地造化的贱役，地狱的产儿！你糟蹋了你生母沉重的胎腹！你是将你送入人间的生父的祸根！你这不要脸的败类、令人发指的——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 玛格莱特！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 理查！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嗳！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我没有叫你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就对不起了，我还以为你叫骂
了半天，都是指的我呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我指的就是你；可是你不要回嘴。呵！等我来结束这场咒骂吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我已代办了，就用“玛格莱特”做结尾。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这样说来，你却诅咒了你自己。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可怜的画中王后，你不过是我幸运墙上所加的浮雕！毒蛛布网缚住你周身，你又何必在它腹鼓上洒糖粉？蠢东西，蠢才！你无非在磨亮的刀口上企图自尽。总有一天你还会希望我来帮你同咒这只口喷毒液的驼背蟾呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 乱嚼舌头的婆娘，莫再狂咒了，当心惹起我们的火，那就对不起你啦。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 无耻之徒！你们先就惹起我的火啦。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 要我们和善相待，你就该懂得你的本分。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 要和善待我，你们应该各尽职守，以臣仆自居，而敬我以国后之礼。呵！和善相待，要懂得你们自己的本分才是。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再莫和她争辩，她是个疯子。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 少开口！小侯爵，你很无礼。你那个新爵印才刚刚出炉，尚未流通呢。呵！愿你这个才出世的贵族子弟也体验到失位之苦而感受些忧伤！高处多劲风，干枝动摇，一旦折断，当心打得你粉身碎骨。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好一篇忠言，的确；记住，记住，侯爵。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这不单指我而言，大人，也牵涉到你呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的，更牵涉到我；不过我生来高贵，雄鹰之子筑巢于松柏之巅，与天风盘桓，太阳也受它奚落。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 阳光也会变得阴沉；唉！呀！请看我的儿子，他已进了死亡的幽谷；你的腾腾杀气已将他那四射的光辉永蔽在黑暗之中。你的鹰栖宿于我们的鹰巢中；呵，上帝呀！你见到了，切莫让他猖狂；用鲜血取得的胜利也该在鲜血中失去！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 罢了，罢了！不讲仁恕，也该讲些体面啰。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么仁恕，什么体面，莫对我提这些。你们从未对我讲过仁恕，我的所有希望都被你们无耻地摧毁了。仁恕在我是横暴，生命是耻辱，而且至今我这团悲愤之火还在耻辱中焚烧呢！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 算了，算了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，尊贵的勃金汉！让我亲你的手，以表示你我之间既协调，也亲善，我祝你和你的高贵的系族得福！你的衣衫上没有沾染我们的血迹，所以你就不包括在我诅咒之内。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这里谁都不在其内；诅咒一出诅咒者之口，便化为乌有了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我却深信咒语可以上达天庭，也能将天帝从安详的睡眠中唤醒。呵，勃金汉！小心那个狗东西：要知道，摇尾的狗会咬人；咬了人，它的牙毒还会叫你痛极而死；莫同他来往，千万留意；罪恶、死亡和地狱都看中了他，地下的大小役吏都在供他使唤。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她说些什么，勃金汉大人？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不值得我倾听的谰言，我的好大人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么，我好意进忠言，你竟鄙弃我吗？我警告你远离魔鬼，你反去奉承他吗？呵，有朝一日他会叫你忧伤心碎，你就要想起此时此地而感叹着说，可怜的玛格莱特真是个女界先知。你们每个人都要成为他的眼中钉，你们也会恨他入骨，上帝还要恨你们大家！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 听她咒骂，真叫我毛骨悚然。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我也如此。我不懂为什么不把她看管起来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我倒不怪她；有圣母为证，她确也受了不少冤屈，我懊悔当初对她犯下了一些过错。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 据我所知，我却从未冒犯过她。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可是她受冤屈，而你们大家却坐享其成。我从前一副热肠，为人作嫁，而今落得个冷淡相遇。呀，克莱伦斯也是咎有应得；他虽尽过力，今天已被关进了养猪圈里了。上帝饶恕那些肇祸生端的人吧！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 有人伤害了你，你反为他祈祷，这却是一条虔心从善的途径。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我一向如此，
因为我自己心中有数；我此刻如果咒骂起来，我就咒骂了自身。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 王后娘娘，国王请您进去；也请您去，大人；还有你们各位公卿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们遵命。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 坏事是我干的，争吵也是我带的头。我策划了一些阴谋诡计又嫁祸于人，让他们去承受。克莱伦斯原是我送进暗牢的，但我又伤心流泪，哭丧着脸给呆子们观看；比如海司丁斯、斯丹莱、勃金汉等人；我告诉他们是王后和她的那伙人煽动国王来对付我的三哥的。现在他们都深信不疑；还鼓励我向利佛斯、伏根、葛雷报仇；我就故意感叹起来，还引据经文，叫他们多多领会神意，要以善报恶：我就这样从《圣经》中偷出些断章残句，来掩饰我的赤裸裸的奸诈真相，外表上装做圣徒，暗中是无恶不作。
可是且低声些！我雇下的刽子手来啦。好呀，我的刚勇坚定的弟兄们！你们现在就去干吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的，我的大人；先来拿证件，才好进入他所在的地方。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 想得周到；证件我准备好了，
你们干完后就来克洛斯比宫。可是，弟兄们，你们下手必须敏捷，尤其要心如铁石，莫去听他申诉；克莱伦斯很能讲话，假如你们理睬他，可能被他打动了心。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不会，不会，我的大人，我们决不讲空话；话多就办不成事。千万放心，我们此去是用手不用嘴巴。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 眼里要落石块，傻子才滴傻泪；我很看得上你俩；快去干起来；去，去，快去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们听命，高贵的王爷。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 您大人今天为什么如此愁容满面哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，我这一夜好难熬过，真不是味，噩梦做不完，奇形怪状都呈现在我眼前，我虽然是个笃信基督的人，我也不愿再度过这样一夜，那种阴森恐怖的景象确实难当，哪怕能换得无边欢乐的日子也是受不了的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 您做的什么梦，大人，请讲给我听听。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我仿佛从塔中脱身出去，上了船正渡海要去勃艮第；我和我弟弟葛罗斯特同路，梦里我见他诱我上甲板散步。我俩向英国眺望，历数着约克和兰开斯特两王室彼此交战的艰难岁月，我们经受着无穷的灾厄。正当我两人在那令人晕眩的甲板上缓步徐行，似乎葛罗斯特一失足；我挽住他，他却一手打来，把我摔下海去，在那滚滚浪涛之中我反复浮沉。天哪，天哪！我好像深感淹没水中之苦；浪涛声在耳朵边响着，十分可怕！我眼睛里浮现出种种死亡的怪状！我仿佛看见千百条遇险的破船；上千的人被海鱼啮食着；海底散满了金块、大锚、成堆的珍珠、无价的宝石和难以计值的饰品。有的嵌进了死人的头颅；在原来安装眼珠的空洞里嵌着闪亮的珠宝，似乎在侮慢肉眼，不断地向那泥泞的海底传情，对着散在各处的枯骨嘲笑。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你在死去的一刹那间，哪有闲工夫去观察海底的秘密呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我仿佛觉得有闲工夫；但我也多次想摆脱生命；可是浪潮不肯留情，堵塞了我的灵魂，不放它出去寻求那广阔、荒凉、无定的太空；我的灵魂被阻，摆脱不了这喘息的躯壳，使我全身似乎要崩裂，恨不得将灵魂吐入海中。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你这样痛苦万分，竟未能苏醒吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 没有，没有，我生命虽已告终，而梦境却延续着；呵！我的灵魂一时激荡起来，像风雨般不能安定。我仿佛渡过了阴阳界上的黯流，那诗人们所歌唱的冷脸舟子把我带进了长夜漫漫的幽国。我这个新到的亡魂迎头便遇见了我的丈人，那位闻名世上的华列克；他高声嚷道，“这冥府里能有什么严刑峻法足以惩办这个叛逆无道的克莱伦斯哪？”说着，他就消失了；随后，飘过一个天使般的阴影，它的亮发上带着血迹；口中厉声叫着，“克莱伦斯来了，——虚伪、善变、背誓的克莱伦斯，他在图克斯伯雷战场上刺杀了我；——来抓住他！怨鬼们，抓他去上酷刑。”这时我仿佛觉得有成群的恶妖围住了我，在我耳边叫嚷，那惊人的尖厉声将我吓醒，我满身发颤，许久还以为自己仍旧身在幽国，这场梦在我脑中印下了难以磨灭的可怕痕迹。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 难怪您，大人，莫说您自己吓坏了；单是听您讲，我就很害怕啦。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，勃莱肯伯雷，我所干的那些事，为的是爱德华，而今天成为控诉我灵魂的实证；请看他却是如何酬谢我的。上帝呀！如果我真诚祈祷还不够使您息怒，而坚决要惩罚我的错误，那就至少只在我一人头上泄愤吧；呵，千万饶过我那无辜的妻子儿女。我恳求你，好狱官，不要离开我；我的心魂好生沉重，我很想睡一会儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我陪伴您，大人，愿上帝赐您安眠！
忧思分割着时季，扰乱着安息，把夜间变为早晨，昼午变为黑夜。王公贵人无非把称号头衔当做尊荣，以浮面的声誉换取满心的苦恼；为了虚无缥缈的感受他们往往亲尝无限烦愁：原来在他们的尊号和一些贱名之间，只涌现着浮华虚荣，哪里找得出一条明白的分界线。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嗨，有谁在这儿？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你要干什么，伙计？你怎么来的？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来跟克莱伦斯谈话，是两只腿走来的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么！这样简单？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 先生，简单比噜苏好，——给他看我们的证件，不必多说。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 证件上叫我把这位高贵的克莱伦斯公爵交你们处理；此中用意我不想多作推敲，因为用意归用意，莫连累了我。公爵睡在那边，钥匙在那儿。我去见国王；向他禀明我已经把我的职守移交给你们了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去好了，先生，这样才叫做识相；再会。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嘿！我们就趁他睡着时候下刀吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不好；他醒过来会说我们做事没有胆量。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他醒过来！嗨，傻瓜，不到审判末日他再也醒不过来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嗨，那末他会说我们是趁他睡着时候下手的啦。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 提起审判两个字，倒叫我有些心惊呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么！你害怕了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 手里拿的是证件，杀他倒不成问题；只是杀了他，灵魂就会万劫不复，什么证件也救不了我呀。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我满以为你是很坚定的哪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 让他活，我是坚定的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我回到葛罗斯特公爵那儿去告诉他。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不，请你且等一下，我希望我这一丝丝软心肠儿就会转变的；一向是数不到二十，我这种心念就要把不住了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你这一刻的感觉怎样？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我身子里还剩下一点儿良心的渣屑呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不要忘记事情干完了我们就可以领赏哪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他妈的！他死成了；我把赏金给忘了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 现在你的良心又哪儿去了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 在葛罗斯特公爵的钱袋里。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可见在他打开钱袋来给我们赏金的时候，你那颗良心便飞走啦。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不相干；让它去；很少人，可以说没有一个人，能留得住它的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如果它又回来了，你怎么办呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我不再跟它打交道了；它叫人缩手缩脚，办不成事；偷不得，一偷，它就来指手画脚；赌不得咒，一赌咒，它就来阻挡你；不能和邻家妻子通奸，一动，它就识破了你；它是个脸会发红、躲躲闪闪的妖精，会钻进人家肚子里造反的家伙；它老是把你的路堵得严严的；有一次我偶尔拾来一袋金子，就是它硬叫我去归还原主的；谁收留了它就会弄得谁颠颠倒倒，一副穷酸相；谁都会把它当作一个倒楣蛋，赶出城去；凡是想生活得好一些的人，都努力使自己站起来，不去靠它过日子。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他妈的！它居然还躲进我的怀里来劝我莫杀公爵呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 赶快把恶魔扣住在你心头，莫去听良心的话；它最能骗人上当，老是叫你长嘘短叹的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嘿，我是铜筋铁骨；它别想来碰我。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 真是好汉口气，不愧英雄本色。来，我们干起来吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 用你的刀柄打他的头颅，再把他丢进隔壁房间的大酒桶里去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，好办法！让他在酒里泡成一根软面条儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 低声些！他醒了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 动手吧！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不，我们来同他谈谈。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你在哪儿呀，狱官？给我一杯酒喝。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 就来，大人，有的是酒给你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的天哪，你是谁？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是一个人，同你一样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可是并不像我一样出身高贵。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你也不像我们一样浑身忠诚。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 听你嗓子像雷鸣，看你样子很低微。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我此刻的嗓子是王上的，我的面貌却还是我自己的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的话讲得何其模糊，又何其险恶！你们的目光吓坏我啦，你们为什么脸色苍白？谁打发你们来的？来干什么？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来杀害我？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呃……呃。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你们简直硬不起心肠来把一句话讲出口，也就硬不起心肠来对我下毒手。朋友们，我在哪儿得罪你们两位啦？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你没有得罪过我们，可是你得罪了王上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我要和他言归于好。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不可能了，大人；还是准备死吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你们是从世人中间特别挑选出来杀害无辜之人的吗？我犯了什么罪？哪儿有控告我的证据？谁依法陪审了？交给那疾首蹙额的法官的是什么判决书？还是有谁正式宣布我这伤心的克莱伦斯是被判死罪了的？没有经过法律手续就拿死来吓唬我，这完全是违法乱纪的行为。基督流出他尊贵的血偿还了我们深重的罪孽，你们如果还希望基督挽救你们的灵魂，就休要来碰我，赶紧走开；你们这样干是要遭天罚的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们干这件事不过是执行命令罢了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 发出这命令的人就是我们的国王。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 荒谬的子民呀！那崇高的万王之王早已在他的法典上训诫过：不可杀人！你们怎敢违背神旨而奉行一个凡夫的意图？当心；那手执惩仇大锤的是真神，谁犯了天条，谁的头上就要遭到袭击。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你发过假誓，也残杀过人，那神锤照样会打在你的头上；为了兰开斯特王室之争，你曾接受盟誓，参预战事。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你还像叛离神名的人一样，背弃盟誓，使用你叛逆的利刃，把国君的儿子破腹裂肠而死。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 而他正是你所宣誓拥护的人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你既将天条神律破坏无余，岂能反而借此来训斥我们？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！我干下这种恶劣的事是为了谁呀？还不是为了爱德华，我自己的长兄，他不可能为这件事而派你们来杀我；他的罪同我一样深重。如果上帝要惩罚一个作恶的人，呵，你们也该懂得，他会光明正大地做到：神力无穷，用不着凡人从中插手；他决不采取曲折不法的行径来铲除那冒犯神意的人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 当英勇的普兰塔琪纳特初掌国政，正是年富力强的时候，是谁叫你充当凶手将他杀死的呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我哥哥的手足之情、魔鬼和我的忿怒。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你哥哥的手足之情、我们的职责和你的败行促使我们此时来到此地动手杀你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你们如果爱戴我哥哥，就不要仇视我；我是他的弟弟，我很敬爱他。你们如果为赏金而来行刺，就请回去找我弟弟葛罗斯特，他一定会为我重赏你们；爱德华给赏要我死，我弟弟给赏却要我生。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你受骗了，你的弟弟葛罗斯特恨死你了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呀，不对！他是爱我的，而且待我很亲热，请你们去找他好了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对，我们是要去的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去告诉他，当年我们的父王约克用他那胜利的手祝福我们三兄弟，他从心坎上叮咛我们千万要互敬互爱，哪里料到今天我们会阋墙起纷争；只要让葛罗斯特想到这一点，他准会落泪的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对呀，眼里落石块；他倒是教过我们该怎样哭泣的呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！不要毁谤他，他是个好心人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对；正像秋收天飞雪
那样。你想错了，就是他派我们来杀你的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不可能；他和我在路上遇见还痛哭起来，把我抱在怀里，呜呜咽咽发着誓，说他一定尽力救出我去哩。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是啊，他正是要把你救出这个苦海送上天国去享乐呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 求上帝饶恕吧，你已死定了，大人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的灵魂深处居然还有一点敬神的念头，能让你来劝我求取上帝的饶恕？同时你却又漠视你自己的灵魂，不求安宁，违抗着神意来杀害我？呵！弟兄们，想一想，那指派你们来谋我命的人也会因此而恨你们哩。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们怎么办？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 发发慈悲，救救你们的灵魂。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 发发慈悲！那是懦夫和妇女的事。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 没有慈悲之心的是禽兽，是野人，是魔鬼。假如你们像我一样是皇家之子，囚禁在狱中，假如有两个凶手像你们这样来了，设身处地，你们岂不也要苦苦求饶吗？我的朋友，我看出你那脸上已流露出一点怜悯来了；呵，如果你这目光神色不是假心假意，走过我这边来，来为我求情，好比你处在我的困境里那样哀求吧。哪个乞丐不怜惜乞怜的王孙？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 看你的身背后，大人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （用刀刺他）就这一下，再一下。还不够就把你丢进里边酒桶去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 杀人流血的事，就这样硬着心肠干出来了！我真想学一学彼拉多
洗干净手，不让这种惨绝人寰的凶杀案连累上我。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么啦！你为什么不帮我的忙？天哪，公爵应该知道你简直不肯卖力。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我宁愿他知道我救了他哥哥的命！你拿赏去，把我的话去告诉他；我懊悔杀了这位公爵。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我不懊悔；走你的吧，你反正是个懦夫。好，我来找个洞藏起这具尸首，等公爵下令埋葬时再说。领到了赏金就走我的路；恶事终究要传开的，我决不留在这儿来吃苦头。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
