chinese.text: 呵，好了，今天我算做了一些事。各位贵爵，继续团结友好下去：我天天在等待我的救主赐送福音，把我从世间赎回去；我在世上既使亲友们和平相处了，我的灵魂就更可安宁归天。利佛斯与海司丁斯牵起手来；不要再心怀怨恨，立个誓相爱吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 皇天在上，怨恨已经清出了我的心；我伸出这只手来保证我的真忱。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿我也得福，我同样真心起誓！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 千万莫在你们的君王面前行诈；小心那万王之王诛伐你们，打乱你们的阴谋。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿我得昌达，我立誓精诚无欺！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我也一样，我真心敬爱海司丁斯！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 夫人，你自己也不能例外，还有你，王子道塞特，还有你，勃金汉；你们都曾互不相让，党同伐异。妻后，爱护海司丁斯，让他吻你的手；不管做什么，不可做假。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来，海司丁斯；我决不再记旧怨，我和我的亲人都愿得昌达！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 道塞特，拥抱他；海司丁斯，敬爱侯爵。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这番情谊的交流，我在此宣誓，我要保持到底。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我也同样宣誓。（他们拥抱。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 现在，高贵的勃金汉，愿你也和王后的亲朋们拥抱，作为你和他们团结的保证，也好让我看着高兴。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我勃金汉如果有时也仇视王后，或是不衷心拥戴你和你的亲朋，我愿受天罚，让我众叛亲离，恩爱反成冤仇！即便在我最需要一个十分可靠的朋友的时刻，我也宁愿他待我刻薄、诡诈、险恶！我若一旦对你或你的亲朋冷酷无情，愿上帝将这种种逆境加在我身上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你这一誓愿，尊贵的勃金汉，对我这有病的身心确是一服良药。现在，只可惜葛罗斯特兄弟不在场，否则这番和好的局面就更圆满了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 凑巧的很，高贵的公爵来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的国君和王后，祝你们今天好；各位贵爵，愿你们这一天快乐！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们这一天的确很快乐。葛罗斯特，我们完成了许多好事；在这些怨愤满腹的公侯之间，干戈化成了玉帛，恨转为爱了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的至上的君王，这确是值得祝贺的功绩。在这许多公侯之中，如果有人误听谗言，或者猜测谬误，把我当作仇人看待；如果我在无意之中，或一时动怒，干下了任何令人难忍的事，我愿意和他消释嫌怨，言归于好。我最恨人与人之间造成不和；我愿人人爱我。首先，王后，我要求你我之间消除隔阂，我一定努力争取和好；对你也一样，我的贵亲勃金汉，如果你我曾心生嫌隙的话；你们也不例外，利佛斯和道塞特两位大人，虽然你们一度无故对我怒目相视；还有你，伍德维尔、斯凯尔斯大人
，至于各位公爵伯爵，王侯贵族，你们也都在内。我想不起有哪一个英国人不是像今夜初生的婴孩一样，我心中竟会对他还存有丝毫芥蒂。感谢上帝，我能以谦恭待人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 从今以后永远记取这神圣的一天，我愿上天让人间裂痕全都补尽。我的主君，我还要请求陛下对皇弟克莱伦斯开恩。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么，王后，我一番真情却换来你在国王面前如此轻慢相待吗？谁不知道那位尊贵的公爵已经死了？（全场大惊失色）你这样拿他的遗体开玩笑太对不起人了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 谁不知道他已经死了！谁知道他死了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 老天有眼，这是个什么世界！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 道塞特大人呀，个个脸都变白了，我脸上怎样？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，好大人；在场的人谁不是魂不附体，面呈土色。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 克莱伦斯死了吗？成命已经收回了的呀。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可怜他在你的原令一到便已服刑，那王命传来犹如神使天降；你的撤销令姗姗来迟，徒见他尸体已经僵硬，埋进了黄土。天哪，那班不够高贵、不够忠诚的人，他们怀着血腥的思想，说不上有什么骨肉之情，但愿这班人不致遭受克莱伦斯同样的厄运，且看他们逍遥法外，好生自在。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 主君呀，臣已尽职，特来请赏！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 请你莫噜苏，我心中十分愁烦。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 陛下不听，臣只得伏地不起。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就赶快讲吧，讲出你的请求来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 诺福克公爵有一名侍者，在辞退之后，酗酒闹事，今天被我仆人杀死，因而特地来为我仆人请罪，求陛下开恩。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我怎能一嘴两舌，既判决我弟弟死刑，而又同时赦免你的仆人？我弟弟并未杀人，他仅仅是一念之差，竟而叫他遭受了杀身之祸。有谁为他请过命的？在我一时愤怒之余，有谁来跪请进谏过的？有谁提起过兄弟骨肉之情？有谁对我叙述过那伤心的人儿曾经抛弃了勇猛的华列克而为我作战？有谁对我谈起过，当牛津伯爵把我击倒在图克斯伯雷战场上，是他亲手救了我，还说道，“亲哥哥，你活下去，为一国之君”？有谁又说过，当我俩冻卧疆场，他脱下了战袍为我御寒；他不顾自己是单衣薄裤，却听那寒夜冷气麻木着他的手脚？可恨我这野兽般的一股怒气竟叫我把这么多恩情全给忘掉，灭绝了人性，而你们却无一人怀着善心来促动我思量。可是当你们手下的搬夫侍役，酗酒杀人，毁损了我们亲爱的救主所塑造的形象，你们反而急急忙忙来跪请恕罪，唠叨不休；而我还得不顾法理，一口允免；至于我兄弟冤死，谁都不来提醒半句，我自己更是毫无心肝，未曾稍加思考，呵，可怜的冤魂。你们中间最得意的人都曾经亏他提携，却未见一人肯为他请命。呵，上帝呀！我怕天道无私，你和我，或我们的亲朋，都不免要遭到灾厄了。来吧，海司丁斯，扶我进内室去。唉，伤心的克莱伦斯！

chinese.text: 约克大主教、小约克、伊利莎伯王后及约克公爵夫人上。

chinese.text: 我听说他们是昨天在诺桑普敦过夜的；今晚他们在斯特拉福住下，明天或后天就可以到达这里了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我一心盼望能看到亲王。希望他比我上次看见时长得高大了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我听说他没有长高多少；他们说我的小儿约克已经赶上了哥哥。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的，母亲，但我不愿如此。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么啦，我的小孙儿，长得高大多么好。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 祖母，有一天晚上，我们正吃着晚饭，利佛斯舅父谈到我比哥哥长得快，“哈哈，”葛罗斯特叔叔就说道，“芸香娇滴滴，贱草处处生。”我听了就私下忖度，我不想长得快，因为香花迟迟发，野草日夜长。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的老天爷，他对你引用的这句成语，对他自己可并不适用哪；他幼时是个再讨厌不过的东西，成长得十分迟缓，拖拖沓沓，所以他这句话如果有道理，他今天就该器宇非凡哪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好太后，他无疑也可以算得一个吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 但愿如此；可是为母的怎能放心。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对了，当真的，我假如早想到的话，当时我倒可以同叔叔开个玩笑，把他的成长说得更切题一些。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么说，我的小约克？你且说给我听听。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哈，据说我叔叔长得好快，才生下两小时他就能啃嚼面包壳；我却两周岁才长出一颗牙呢。祖母，这岂不是一件笑死人的趣闻吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我倒问你，好孩子，是谁告诉你的？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 祖母，是他的奶妈。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他的奶妈！她死的时候你还没有出世呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不是她，我就说不上是谁了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 多嘴的孩子：嗨，你也太机灵了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好夫人，莫同孩子认真。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 水罐也有两只耳朵，何况小孩子呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来了一个使者。有什么消息？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的大人，这消息说出来我也很难过。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 亲王怎样？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 很好，王后，很健康。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的消息是什么？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 利佛斯和葛雷两位大人被押到邦弗雷特去了，还有托马斯·伏根爵士也一起下狱了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是谁把他们下狱的？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 两位大公爵，葛罗斯特和勃金汉。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么罪状？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我所能了解的我都讲出来了；至于这些贵爵们所犯何法，为什么下狱，我全不知道，我的好大人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的天哪！眼见我的一家人就此毁了！猛虎已经抓住了驯鹿，蛮横无道的暴政开始在蹂躏软弱无能的皇家宝座；来吧，毁灭、死亡和凶残的屠杀！摆在眼前的就是一幅荒凉的残局。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 多少可诅咒的动荡的岁月都打我眼底喧嚷着过去了！我的夫君为了争取王冠而丧命，我的儿辈时起时落不得安顿，他们得意我欢乐，失意我啼哭。萧墙风云曾被吹散，王位得以安定，可是战胜者却又你争我夺，同室操戈，自相残杀。灭天理，绝人性，疯狂的暴行，呵，那弥天的怨氛应可罢休了；否则我宁愿一死，也不要再见到死亡。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来，来，我的孩子；我们去圣堂躲难。老夫人，再会了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 等一下，我要和你们同去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你没有必要。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的好王后，去吧；把你的珍品用物一齐带去。在我这方面，我将交出国玺由你保管，王后；按目前的处境我只有尽力这样照料你和你的一切了！来，我领你们进圣堂去。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 爱德华王负病上，伊利莎伯王后、道塞特、利佛斯、海司丁斯、勃金汉、葛雷及余人等上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （对王后）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 葛罗斯特上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 斯丹莱上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （爱德华王、王后、海司丁斯、利佛斯、道塞特、葛雷均下。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （同下。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 伊利莎伯王后举动癫狂；利佛斯与道塞特随上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 葛罗斯特、勃金汉、斯丹莱、海司丁斯、拉克立夫及余人等上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （旁白）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （除勃金汉及葛罗斯特外，均下。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （同下。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （同下。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 使者上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （对王后）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （同下。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 奏乐。威尔士亲王、葛罗斯特、勃金汉、凯茨比、布希埃红衣主教及余人等上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 欢迎，好亲王，欢迎你到达了伦敦，你的都城。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 欢迎，亲爱的侄儿，我心目中的主君；旅途劳顿使你精神困乏了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 没有，叔叔；我们在途中的周折却叫人感到有些厌倦和烦闷，我以为还有长辈来接我呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好亲王，你年事还轻，阅世比较浅，没有看明白人心的险诈。人的本质和他的表面言行你还不能辨别；真可以说，上帝知道，表里一致的人是绝无仅有的。你所想见的长辈都是居心险恶的；殿下受了他们甜言蜜语的迷惑，一点没有注意到他们那颗毒辣的心。愿神保佑你，不让你靠近这班虚伪的亲朋！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 神保佑我，不让我靠近他们！可是他们并非虚伪的人哪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 亲王殿下，伦敦市长来向你请安啦。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 上帝祝福你健康安乐！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 谢谢你，我的好大人；谢谢你们大家。我以为我母亲和弟弟约克早就会在途中和我相会了。嗨！海司丁斯真像个蜗牛，他还没有来报告他们会不会就来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这位大人来得巧，他赶出汗来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 欢迎，我的大人。怎么，我的母亲来不来？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的母后和弟弟约克竟投奔圣堂去了，为的什么只有天知道，我弄不懂；那年幼的王子还极想跟我来会见殿下的，可是他母亲却把他勉强留住了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嗨！她这一举动是何等迂拙，何等无聊！主教大人，可否请你去走一趟，劝王后放约克公爵马上来和他长兄亲王见面？如果她不肯，海司丁斯大人，就请你也同去，把王子从她怀里抢出来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的勃金汉大人，如果我能凭三寸不烂之舌从他母亲身边赢回约克公爵，你马上就会在此见到他；但是她若固执己见，不听我好言劝说，那就难办了，天帝不容我们侵犯圣堂的尊严！无论怎样，我为了全国的福泽，决不敢犯下如此深重的罪孽。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你未免过分顽固了，我的大人，太拘泥礼节，墨守成规了；只要能依从今天的习俗，作全面的考虑，提拿他也不算犯圣堂的禁规。一个值得受圣堂保护或懂得请求保护意义的人，才能允许他享受这种权利。这位王子既无权请求，也不应该享受；因此，据我看，就不能得到什么保护。提走一个不属于圣堂的人，当然并未侵权，也未犯法。我虽常听说成年人躲进圣堂，但孩童也受到神护，我今天才第一次听到呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的大人，这一次我听你的吩咐。来吧，海司丁斯大人，你和我同去吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我去，我的大人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 两位好大人，请你们速去速来。
且说，葛罗斯特叔叔，我弟弟来了，我们在哪里等候加冕呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 殿下看哪儿最好就在哪儿。如果听我的意见，在几天之内尊驾不妨去伦敦塔中暂作休息；之后，由你再决定，只消是最宜于你的健康和消遣的地方就行。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哪儿都好，我就不喜欢伦敦塔；我的大人，这塔堡是凯撒初建的吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的好殿下，是由他开始建造的，后来一代一代继续改建。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他创建的事是载进史册的吗，还是世代口传下来的？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 史册上是有记载的，我的好殿下。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不过，即使无案可查，我的大人，我想这事绩仍该流传下去，好让它代代相承，传之无穷，直到人类的审判末日为止。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 人们说，才华早发，断难长命。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你说什么，叔叔？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我说，史乘不载，声誉长存。
就这样，好比传统戏剧里那个名叫“孽障”的丑角一样，我也来个一词两用，故弄玄虚。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这位凯撒是个有名的人物；他的勇气丰富了他的聪明，聪明又为他的勇气栽下了根。死亡并不能征服这位征服者，他的生命虽已结束，可是声名不灭。我来告诉你一句话，我的阿舅勃金汉，——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么话，我的好大人？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我如果长大成人，我要去法国夺回我们自古世袭的主权，否则我生为君王，就死为战士。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 开春过早，往往使夏令短促。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呀，约克公爵已到，来得正好。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 约克的理查！我亲爱的弟弟，一向好？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好，我的可敬畏的君王，我该这样称呼你了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 唉，弟弟，是我的，也是你的不幸；应该享有尊称的人竟匆匆辞别了人间，多少威望都跟他一同消逝了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的贤侄约克公爵无恙吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 多谢你，好叔叔。呵，我的大人，你说过，闲草蔓生，长得很快；我的长兄亲王长得却比我高多了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是的，我的殿下。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 难道他就是闲草一根吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，我的好侄儿，我决不能这样说。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那末，他比我更应该多多向你道谢啰。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 作为一个君王他可以命令我；而你也可以作为一个亲戚来驱使我。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我恳求你，叔叔，给我这把刀。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我这把刀吗，小侄儿？那没有问题。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 见东西就伸手讨吗，弟弟？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 向我的好叔叔讨，我知道他一定会给；不过是一个小玩具，不致于伤他的心。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再大的礼物我也会给我的侄儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再大的礼物！呵，那就是这把剑了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呀，好侄儿，但愿它不会太重。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，我这才懂了，你只肯给轻礼；问你讨较重的礼你就会拒绝。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 殿下佩上这东西会嫌沉重哪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再重些我也会觉得轻微。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么！你当真要我的刀剑吗，小殿下？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我当真要，好让我按你的称呼答谢你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么讲？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 小就小谢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的约克公爵还是爱抬杠。叔父，你自然能宽容他的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你是说，把我背起来，不是宽容我；叔叔，我哥哥把我俩都嘲笑到了。因为我长得小，像个猴儿一样，他认为你就该把我背在肩头上。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他好生善辩，如此锋利而敏捷！为了要缓和对他叔父的轻慢，他巧妙而恰当地把自己也嘲弄了一顿；年纪这样幼小，却已这样伶俐，真了不起。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的殿下，就请动身吧？我自己和我的好兄弟勃金汉就去探视你母亲，去恳求她先到伦敦塔等候接驾。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么！你要去伦敦塔吗，我的主君？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的护国公大人决定这么办。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 在伦敦塔里我不能安眠。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为什么，你怕什么？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵哟，我的叔叔克莱伦斯的怨魂；祖母对我说，他就是在塔中被杀的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我倒不怕死了的叔叔和舅舅。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我希望活的你也不会怕。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如果是活的，我巴不得不必怕他。好吧，我的大人；我心头沉重，一面想念着他们死者，一面走进伦敦塔。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 依你看，我的大人，这个口里叽叽哇哇的小约克，该不是受了他那狡诈母亲的煽动，才会对你如此无礼，如此任意嘲弄吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 当然，当然。呵！好难对付的孩子；大胆，敏捷，灵巧，无顾忌，能干；他从头到脚就是他母亲的化身。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好，让他们安息去吧。凯茨比，你走过来；你发过誓要彻底完成我们的意图，也同样坚决地要严守我们的秘密。我们一路陈述的道理你也听见了，现在你看怎样？如果要威廉·海司丁斯大人来共襄盛举，把这位勋爵拥登这名邦的宝座，你想容易办到吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他为了先王之故，与亲王情谊深厚，因此决难叫他转过脸来反对他。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你看斯丹莱怎么样？他会怎样做？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他会同海司丁斯完全一致行动。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那么，请你就这样办；去，好凯茨比，你且从旁去观察一下海司丁斯的心意，试探他对我们这个意图有些什么想法；同时邀请他明天来伦敦塔参与加冕礼。如果你见他有可能转变过来，就鼓励他，把全部道理告诉他：假如他无动于衷，冷冰冰，固执，你也可以照样对待，不必多谈，只要把他的心意通知我们；因为我们明天想分庭议事，你要负起重任呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为我向威廉大人致意：告诉他，凯茨比，他那多年来结下的生仇死恨明天要看到分晓，邦弗雷特堡宅要染上鲜血，代我转告他大人在庆得喜讯之后，不妨亲热地多吻一下可爱的休亚夫人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好凯茨比，去吧，去把这件事办妥。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 两位好大人，我一定尽心去办。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 凯茨比，在我们就寝之前能听见你的回音吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可以的，我的大人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 到克洛斯比宫来可以找到我们。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 万一，我的大人，我们发觉海司丁斯大人不肯和我们一起行事，那又怎么办？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 砍掉他的头；一不做，二不休。等我当了国王，你就来请封海瑞福德伯爵的爵位，把那里我王兄原有的一切动产也都赏给你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我会来向殿下请赏的啰。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 放心，我一定会诚意封赏给你的。好了，是我们进晚餐的时间啦，饭后我们还要从长计议，拟出妥善办法来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 大人！我的大人！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （在内）谁在敲门？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 斯丹莱大人派来的人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: （在内）几点钟了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 正敲着四点钟。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 漫漫长夜，斯丹莱大人难道不能安睡吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 似乎是如此，且听我说来就知道了。首先，他要向你大人致候。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 然后呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 然后，他要我向你大人说明，他夜来梦见一只野猪劫走了他的头盔。他还说，朝廷召开两个会议；在其中一个会上所决定的措施要叫你和他两人在另一个会上遭殃。因此他派我来问你是否愿意和他一起尽快的骑马投奔北方去，免得遭受他心中所揣测的无妄之灾。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去，伙计，去回报你的主子；叫他不必担心那分头的会议。他大人和我参与一个会，在另一个会上有我的好友凯茨比；只消议到有关我俩的事我都会知道。告诉他，他的虚惊是没有根据的；至于他的梦，我奇怪他竟这样迂拙，睡眠不安，梦多欺人，怎能相信。野猪赶上来，我们如果在它前面奔跑，正好惹动野性，追赶得更紧，岂不反招致祸害？你去叫你主子一起身就来找我；我俩一同去伦敦塔，他自然会看见那野猪对我们很客气呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我去了，大人，就去转呈你的高见。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿我尊贵的大人朝朝健康安乐！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你今早好，凯茨比；这一早你就起身转动了呀。什么消息？在我们国家如此动荡之中，你带来了什么消息哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 的确这是个混沌的世界，我的大人；据我看这局面莫想拨正，除非理查戴上了国家的花冠。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么！戴花冠！你说的是王冠吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是呀，我的好大人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我宁愿我这副头颅被砍掉，就是不愿看到那顶王冠戴错了头。可是你猜想他真的打着这个主意吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是呀，我以生命担保，他还希望你能积极参加他一起分享利润呢；因此他叫我带一个喜信给你，说你的旧仇，那些王后的亲戚，就在今天要死于邦弗雷特堡中。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 当真，听到这个消息我倒不必哀悼，因为他们始终与我为敌；然而要我对理查表示拥护，阻挡我主君的后人合法承嗣，上帝知道，我死也不会干。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿上帝让你大人忠贞不渝！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可是这班家伙唆使了我的主君对我心生嫌恶，今天居然还叫我亲眼见到他们的悲惨下场，在今后一年之内还会落得我好笑呢。凯茨比哪，单看我等不到半个月，还要乘其不备解决他几个呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的好大人，叫人们事先一无准备就送了命，该是件丧德的事吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，真可怕，真可怕！眼前已有利佛斯、伏根、葛雷，正走上这条路；此外，也还有些人要遭到同样的厄运，满以为他们和你我一样安全；哪知道你我却是理查和勃金汉两位贵公的亲信之人呢，这是你很清楚的啰。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 两位贵公都很器重你的；
器重他的头颅，要挂上伦敦桥。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我知道他们是这样看待我的，我也可当之无愧了。
来呀，来呀；老兄，你那打猎的矛呢？你怕野猪却又不随身带矛哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的大人，早安；早安，凯茨比。你尽可多开些玩笑，但是，有十字架为证，我还是不爱听什么分头会议。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的大人，我同你一样珍惜生命；可是我要声明，我活到如今还没有像今天这样觉得生命可贵呢。你只要想，我如果不知道我们的处境稳妥，哪儿还能这样兴高采烈哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 在邦弗雷特的大人们，当他们骑马出伦敦的时候，岂不也是无忧无虑，稳若磐石，的确他们本无丝毫疑忌的必要；然而你该看到如何阴霾四起，多么快，一忽儿就翻了脸追杀起来，真叫我忐忑不安；我说，但愿上帝让我做一个无中生有的胆小鬼吧！呀，时候不早了，我们该去伦敦塔了吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来吧，来吧，我跟你走。你知道吗，我的大人？今天你说的勋爵们要处斩了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

一从吏上。

怎么啦，老弟！你近来生活得好吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 有你大人照拂自然要好些。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我告诉你，老弟，我近来倒不错，比上次你我在此相会的时候还好一点。上次我正是被押入狱，都是王后的党羽陷害我；可是今天哪——你听着莫泄漏出去——今天那些冤家要服死刑，而我的处境却大有改进了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿上帝照看你到底，赐你安乐！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对呀，老弟；拿去，为我去痛饮一顿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

一牧师上。

chinese.text: 谢谢你，好约翰先生，我衷心感谢。我前次听你讲经还没有给你酬劳；再到安息日我一定要补偿你。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 理查·拉克立夫爵士，请听我讲一句话：今天你将看见一个臣子，为了求真理、尽职守和忠君王而死。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿亲王得福，求上天保佑他摆脱你们这群野兽！你们简直是一堆罪该万死的吸血虫。

chinese.text: 快走；你们的生命之路已到了尽头。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 邦弗雷特呀，邦弗雷特！你这座血腥的牢狱！贵爵王公的不祥之地，绝命之所！在你这充满罪恶的四壁之内，理查二世曾被乱刀砍死；现在，为了加深你这幽狱的恶名，我们又以无辜的血向你献祭。

chinese.text: 玛格莱特当时诅咒过海司丁斯和你我等人，因为我们眼见理查刺杀她的儿子，却站在一边，若无其事，此刻她的恶咒果然应验了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 当时她也诅咒了理查，也诅咒了勃金汉，也诅咒了海司丁斯。上帝呀！你现在接受了她对我们的诅咒，不可忘了还有他们；为了我姊姊和她那两位王子，亲爱的神，愿你就满足于我们的热血吧，反正你也知道，这场流血冤狱是无从避免的了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 赶快；你们就刑的时分已经逼近了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来，葛雷，来，伏根；我们拥抱一下，说声再会，等到天国重聚首。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 勃金汉、斯丹莱、海司丁斯、伊里主教、拉克立夫、洛弗尔等人围桌议事。会场官兵守卫。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 各位大人都在此，我们现在聚会要对加冕的事作出决定。凭上帝之名，请发言，哪一天举行典礼最好？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 加冕盛典都准备好了吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 都齐备了；只等决定日期。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那么我认为明天就是个好日子。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 关于这一点有谁知道护国公的高见如何？谁同这位尊贵的公爵过从最密哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们看来，您阁下只消问一下，就能知道他的心意了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我和他是彼此知面不知心；他不了解我的心和我不了解你们的心一样；我也不了解他，我的大人，等于你们不了解我一样。海司丁斯大人，你和他很接近。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 感谢他殿下，我知道他待我很厚；不过他对加冕这件事的打算我却没有问过，他也没有表示过有关这件事的意见。可是，你们各位高贵的大人不妨提出日期；我可以代替公爵发言，我敢说，他应该不会见怪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 真凑巧，公爵自己来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的高贵的大人们，亲朋们，各位早安。我起身太迟了；不过，会议上原可决定的国家大事，我相信，并没有因为我迟到而给耽误吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 国王加冕的事，我的大人，如果您没有应声而至，威廉·海司丁斯大人就会替您宣读了，那就是说，替您作了发言。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 还有谁比海司丁斯大人更加大胆的；这位大人知我很深，爱我也很厚。我的伊里大人，我上次在贺尔堡看见您的花园里有很好的草莓，我要求您叫人去摘一些来给我。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好的，我就去拿来，我的大人，我十分愿意效劳。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 勃金汉老弟，同你讲一句话。（两人走向一边）凯茨比探知了海司丁斯对我们这件事的心意，他这个急性子还非常激动，宁可脑袋落地，决不肯让他所尊崇的那位主君之子丧失英国的王位。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你离席出去；我和你一同走。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们还没有定下这欢庆的日期。我看，明天未免过早；如果能稍稍推后一些，我更好准备得妥善些。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 葛罗斯特公爵大人哪儿去了？我已经叫人去把草莓拿来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 今天早上他殿下很高兴，很和气；看他那样风趣地打着招呼，该是他心里有什么得意的事。我想世上再没有人会像他那样喜怒都藏不住的了；只消看他的脸色你就知道他心中想些什么。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你今天从他的脸色上又看出了哪些心思呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，他同我们在座的人都是十分融洽的；否则，他早就要形之于色了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我请教各位，如果有人施展妖术，谋我的性命，还用恶魔的符咒，伤我肉身，这个人该当何罪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 以我对殿下的深情厚谊，我的大人，我敢当着各位贵爵的面前判定这奸人有罪，不论他是谁；我说，大人，这种人是死有余辜的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就请你们亲眼证实他们的罪行。请看我的身子受了妖魔多大的灾害；我这只臂膀就像毁损了的幼树苗一样，全都枯萎了。这便是爱德华的妻，她这个妖妇和那淫欲成性的娼妓休亚，同施妖法，竟把我害成这副模样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 假如她俩做下了这样的事，尊贵的大人——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 假如！你为这该死的娼妇搪塞，你还来对我说什么“假如”、“假如”吗？叛徒，砍下他的头来！现在，我以圣保罗为誓，我不看到他的头颅落地决不进餐。洛弗尔和拉克立夫，负责去照办；其余赞助我的人，站起来，跟我走。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 伤心呀，英国的前途，伤心呀！我个人何足道哉；是我太愚蠢了，我早就该预料到的呵。斯丹莱梦见了野猪劫走他的头盔；是我轻慢行事，不屑逃生。今天我这匹披锦的骏马三次颠蹶，它望见伦敦塔就起惊，似乎它也不想把我载到屠宰场去。呵！此刻我需要那个和我交谈的牧师了；悔不该对从吏自鸣得意，说什么我的仇人们今天要在邦弗雷特惨遭屠杀，而我还自以为安全，庆得恩宠。呀，玛格莱特，玛格莱特！现在你那番沉重的诅咒已落到我可怜的海司丁斯的头上了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 快，赶快，公爵就要用餐了；做个简短的忏悔，他在等着看你的头呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，我们渴求凡人给予片刻的宽限，却没有同样迫切地要求神恕！谁若信任人间的假仁假义，架起空中楼阁，谁就像醉酒的水手高攀船桅；只消一点头他就会翻身落海，沉入万劫不复的深渊。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 快，赶快；叫唤又有何用呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，血腥的理查！悲惨的英格兰！我向你预告，一个最恐怖的时代就要到来。好，带我去断头台，把我的头拿去给他；此刻对我嬉笑的人，在瞬息间自己也休想活得成。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 葛罗斯特及勃金汉上，身穿破旧生锈的甲胄，看来很不入眼。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来，老弟，你能不能身子发抖，脸上变色，一句话没讲完就拦腰切断，从头讲起，又在中途打住，装出疯癫模样，惊惶失措？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嘿！我就会扮演老练的悲剧角色，讲着一句话，回头看看，四下窥视，战战兢兢，草木皆兵，而满腹狐疑；我也会装出假笑，又能运用各种鬼脸怪相；这两副脸谱都由我随意调配，以丰富我的技艺。可是！凯茨比走了吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是呀；看哪，他已带着市长来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 市长大人——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 注意那边的吊桥！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 听哪！鼓声。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 凯茨比，伸出头去看看墙外。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 市长大人，我们所以要请——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 回头看，提防着；有敌人来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿上帝和我们的无辜保佑我们！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 莫慌张，他们是自己人，是拉克立夫和洛弗尔。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这就是那没出息的叛徒的头颅，这个海司丁斯是个心怀叵测的人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这个人我一向喜爱，不能不为他一哭。我原以为在人世呼吸的信徒中他还算得一个道地的老实人；我把他当做我的一本手册，以记录我内心的沉思默想。哪知道他伪装仁义，粉饰着他的污点，因此，如果把他那件公开的败行除外，我所指的是，他与休亚的暧昧关系，他这一生竟是逍遥自在，一手遮掩了天下人的耳目。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 的确，他真是世上唯一善于隐蔽的叛徒了。谁能料到，甚至谁能相信——这个奸徒竟会在今天会议席上谋害我和这位善良的葛罗斯特大人，若不是福星高照，我们哪有活命来相告。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他竟做出这样的事来吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哈！你想我们是土耳其人，或是异教徒吗？或者认为我们愿意不经法律手续就把这人犯任意处死？殊不知当时情势迫在眉睫，国家安危，个人的生死，都在此一举，我们让他服刑，其实是十分不得已的事。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我现在恭祝你们福运好！他是死有应得；你们两位好大人处理得当，可以警诫其他叛徒。自从他和休亚纠缠不清以来，我就料到他再做不出好事了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们原想等您大人来看到他的终局，然后再处决他；无奈我们的朋友们心地忠良，不敢延误，未得我们同意，就先执刑了。本来，我的大人，我们想您如能亲耳听见这叛徒的自白，看到他心惊胆寒地招认他叛逆的经过，供出他用心何在；那样的话，你岂不正好向市民们转达实情，也免得他们会产生误会，反而去为他哀悼起来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的好大人，阁下的话就足够证实了，和我亲眼看见、亲耳听见是一样的；两位尊贵的大人，请不用疑虑，我一定去把你们的公正处理向我们的市民们说明。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我们正是为此而情愿您大人来这一趟，免得人们吹毛求疵，凭空横加指责。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 您虽未能按时赶来，可是现在已听见我们陈述了原有的打算，也就可以说明真相了；好吧，好市长大人，再会了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去，去，跟上去，勃金汉老弟。市长急忙忙地走向市政厅去了；那里你好去看准适当时机，提及爱德华孩子们的出身并不清白；告诉他们爱德华如何冤杀过一个市民，仅仅因为这个市民的住宅前有冠冕为志，号称“冠冕之家”，而他在无意之中却说了一句愿儿子继承“冠冕”。此外，也提出爱德华如何荒淫无度，纵欲横行；以致城中婢仆妻女一个个岌岌自危，只消他淫眼一转，或邪念一动，便放荡无羁，而使百姓遭殃。呃，如果情况需要，您就这样把话转到我本人身上：告知他们，当这个贪欲无厌的爱德华还孕育在我母亲胎中的时候，我父王，那高贵的约克，正出征法国，按时日准确推算，这出生的孩子依理不可能是他亲生的后嗣；单就他的外貌上看也可以说明，他和我尊贵的父王毫不相似。不过关于这一点不妨轻轻带过；因为，我的大人，您知道我母亲还在世呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 放心，我的大人，我一定去雄辩一番，好像是为我自己争取王冠金冕一样；我的大人，我就此告辞了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如果您进行顺利，就把他们带到贝纳堡来；有几位德高望重的神甫和学识渊博的主教要在那里和我作伴呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我去了；将近三四点钟的时候准备听到市政厅传出好消息来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去，洛弗尔，赶紧去见萧神甫；
你去见彭葛神甫；请他们两位在一小时内到贝纳堡来看我。
现在我要进去发出一些机密指示，把克莱伦斯的两个小东西交代了；然后传令禁止任何人在任何时间与两王子有什么接触往来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这就是海司丁斯好大人的判决书；这上面正楷大写，抄得煞是整洁，准备今天在圣保罗教堂宣读：且看这结尾部分衔接得何等紧凑。凯茨比昨晚才把稿子送来，我花了整整十一个小时抄完。拟原稿也用去同样长的时间；不过五小时之前海司丁斯还在人世，没有被控，没有被审，自由自在地满不受管束。这真是个妙不可言的世界！哪个笨汉看不出这么明显的诡计？可是谁又有偌大的胆子，敢说一个字，除非咬紧牙关，只推说不知？世道险阻；眼见这种败行，也只得装聋作哑，藏在心底，这样下去，还成什么世界？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 怎么样啦，怎么样啦！市民们怎样表示？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 有我们救主的圣母在上，市民们都默不作声。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你提到爱德华的孩子们出身不明吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我讲了，也提到他同露西夫人

的关系，以及他派人去法国联姻的事；还讲到他贪色成性，市民的妻子都受到他的蹂躏；事无大小，他无不横行霸道；他在你父亲出征法国的时候出世，血统不正，他面貌也和老公爵满不相像；我还提出了你仪表非凡，心地光明，正同你父亲一模一样；我又向大家铺陈你在苏格兰的战绩，你在军中的纪律，平时的明智，你的宽厚、仁慈和谦逊；可以说，凡是能促成大业的方式我已经用尽了，并且每一点都是着重说明的；当我的讲话接近尾声的时候，我便号召所有的爱国志士齐呼，“上帝保佑国王理查！”

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他们欢呼没有？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 没有，上帝助我，他们默不作声；却像闭口的石像，或喘息的木块一样，彼此呆看着，人人面呈土色；我见了这种光景不由得不申斥他们一顿；后来我转问市长，他们这样沉默无言是何道理？他回答说，人民不习惯于倾听宣讲，除非通过传达。于是我请他代我重述一遍；他却没有肯自己负责讲出一句话来，只顾说，“公爵这样说，公爵的用意是这样”。他说完之后，我自己的几个人在会议厅的一头抛起了帽子，大约有十人左右齐声喊道，“上帝保佑理查王！”这时间我抓紧这几个人呼喊的机会，说道，“感谢各位好市民和朋友们；大家这样异口同声，热情欢呼，说明了你们深明大义，爱护理查。”说着我便走出来了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是些什么哑巴木头人！他们竟不发一言吗？市长和他的同伴们来不来呀？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 市长就来。你装出有些顾虑的模样；除非他竭力恳求，不要理会他；要记住你拿一本祈祷书在手里，站在两个神甫中间，我的好大人；这样我好唱出一套赞美曲来。切莫轻易答应我们的请求；要学姑娘一般口口声声说“不”，然后半推半就接受下来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我去；如果你能为他们请命，而我为自己推让，两人都做得高明，就不愁我们的大事不能成功。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去吧，躲上屋顶去！市长大人在敲门了。
欢迎，我的大人，我正在这里专诚求见；我怕公爵不肯和我们接谈呢。
呵，凯茨比！你主人对我的请求怎样说的？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的尊贵的大人，他恳请阁下等明天或再迟一天来见他。他在里边和两位尊贵的神甫一起虔诚默祷；他不想为世俗事烦心渎神而废止礼拜。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好凯茨比，请你再去禀告贵爵爷，就说我自己和市长，还有各城镇的官长都在这里等候他殿下商讨国家大事，这是与人人的幸福有关的。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我马上去把你的本意转达给他。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，哈，我的大人，这位王公却不像爱德华！他并不在猥亵的榻间安息，却双膝跪地，虔心默拜；也不和左右朝臣一起荒度岁月，却追随着两位富有修养的神甫沉思默想；他并不贪食懒睡，无所用心，却专事祈祷，以丰富性灵。如果能有这位善德善行的王公负起国家重任，英国就万幸了；可是我担心我们很难说动他的心呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如果他殿下拒绝的话，愿上帝保佑我们！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我怕他会固执不移。凯茨比回来了。
呵，凯茨比，他殿下怎样说啦？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他感到奇怪，你们聚集了成队的市民要和他接谈，为的是什么，他殿下事先未有准备；我的大人，他怕您对他不存善意。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的尊贵的兄长竟对我生疑，说我来意不善，叫我心中很是难堪。有上天为证，我们此来是出于至诚；还请你再去一次，禀知殿下。
圣洁虔诚的信徒在诵经礼拜的时候，春风满怀，心意坚贞；要想他转移思念委实很不容易。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 看哪，他殿下站在两位神甫之间呢！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这一对德高望重的支柱，扶持着虔诚在心的君王，免得他堕入虚荣；看呀，他手里还捧着一本祈祷书呢；这才是一个圣者的真实标志呵。满载盛誉的普兰塔琪纳特，至德的王公，愿您垂听我们的请求，我们打断了您的祈祷，妨碍了您的一片真忱，还请您宽恕。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的大人，不用这样道歉；应该是我请您恕我无礼，我只顾诚心祈祷，为上帝争光荣，未能马上接待各位朋友，有负盛意。不过，这暂且不提，请问阁下有何指教？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我希望这正是一件顺天应人的事，也是这岛国上的无主良民所一心向往的事。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我很怕我犯了什么错误，全市人民看不入眼；因而您此刻来责难我，怪我做了错事还不自知。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 您确实是如此，我的大人；望殿下接受我们的恳求，借以改正您的过错！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 当然，否则我怎能在人间求生存呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就请听我冒昧陈辞吧，您不该再三推辞，放弃至尊的宝座，那是您祖代相传的威权所在，是您福运降临，也是您世袭而来的名分，您奕奕皇室的世代光荣，岂能由您让给一支腐朽的系族；您在高枕无忧之中悠思遐想，而这块皇土正等待着大力扶持，为国家前途计，我们特来敦促您醒悟过来；如今纲常不振，面目全非，皇朝正统，凭添枯枝残叶，无以生根，势必陷落深渊，从此湮没无闻。为了拯救这种颓运，我们衷心请求殿下亲自负起国家重任，掌握王权；不再为人作嫁，做一个护政者、家宰、代理人，或当一个卑贱的经手员；您应该维护血统，继承王业，本是您生来的权利，是您的领土，应归您自有。为此之故，我和市民们一起，还有您的虔诚热情的朋友们，都急切地催促着我来向殿下发出这正义呼声，求您垂听下情。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 以我的地位或您的处境看来，我不知道该默然离去此地，还是该严斥您一番。如果我不予作答，您或许认为我是个守口如瓶的野心家，是我眼见您一相情愿地把那辉煌的重担套上我的肩头，而我却默然承受下来了；如果我见您一片至诚，向我求告，我反而横加叱责，这岂不是我又杜绝了友辈的言路。因此，我该既不默然而去，也不严辞驳斥，却把我的心头思念向您作明确的答复。您的热诚值得我衷心感激；但是对我要求过分，我自愧无能，怕难孚众望。首先，即使一切障碍都能扫除，我面前这条登基的道路已经铺平，创业时机已经成熟，只等我继承正统，可是我志气还不够高昂，我德行菲薄，瑕疵多端，缺陷重大，我宁愿闭门思过，以免卷入洪流，好比一叶扁舟，岂敢驶进大海，一旦涌上浪巅，欲罢不能，那就只好在彩光烟雾之中窒息而死了。好在今天还不需要我，感谢上帝；如果讲到需要，我正该多下工夫，自助助人；王室系族留下了王室子嗣，经过日换星移，自可成长起来，来日坐镇朝廷，你我都会臣服而乐事新君。您所要委我的重任，我加在他身上，是天命所归，也是他权分所在；上帝不容我强夺他的王权！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的大人，这确实说明您心地磊落；无奈从多方考虑，您所顾念的都是些不可捉摸的细节。您说爱德华是你大哥的儿子，我们也如此说，却不出自他的妻；早先他和露西夫人订过婚约，至今还有您在世的母亲可以作证，后来又由中间人去法国，向法王的姨妹波娜求婚结盟。此后两人都遭冷落，于是一个多儿的寡母，色衰福浅，竟然乞怜求诉，她虽青春已逝，年已半老，君王却贪淫无度，眉目传情，好比鹰鸟高飞半空，忽而窜落，以致伤风败俗，寡妇重婚；因此一场漠视法纪的结合传下了这个小爱德华，为了保持体面，称为太子。我本可深入揭露，但是为未亡人留些余地，我且话到口边暂留三分。所以，我的好大人，愿您亲自接过我们所呈献的至尊权位；即使不为我们和全国的幸福着想，也该把这祖传的尊贵血统继承下去，匡时拯世，恢复真正的纲纪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 接受吧，好大人；您的市民在请求您了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 伟大的主君，莫拒绝这诚心的献礼。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！让他们欢庆吧，允许他们的合理请求吧！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 唉！你们何必硬要把重担堆在我身上呢？我不配治理国家，不应称君王；务必请你们不要误会，我不能，也不愿，听从你们的要求。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如果您拒绝所请，一心为了爱护您的侄儿，不忍将他废黜；诚如我们在您日常与亲朋过往，处世接物之中，知道您一向心地温厚，待人体贴入微，无奈此刻我们已顾不得您接受与否，反正不能由您侄儿在我国称为君王；我们只好拥立他人继承王位，那样，您的王室势必声名扫地，倾覆无闻：现在我们谨作此决定，并向您告辞。市民们，走吧，我们不再请求了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 叫他们回来，好主君；接受他们的请求。你如果再不应允，全国都要遭殃了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你们真要逼我负起这样烦心的重任吗？叫他们回来；我何尝是铁石心肠，虽然违拗我的心性，我岂能辜负盛情，顽固到底。
勃金汉贤弟，各位父老，你们既不顾我是否愿意，坚持要把命运的重担压上我肩头，勉强我负起重任，从此我就不得不任劳负重，忍受下去；但是万一在你们迫使我登位之后，假若有人暗中攻讦，或破口辱骂，那么此事既由你们促成，一切诟污糟蹋都应与我无关；上帝知道，你们也可能见到，这是一件多么违反我心愿的事。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 上帝祝福您殿下！我们看见了真情，我们要让大家知道。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你们宣扬出去必须根据事实。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 现在我向您称君道贺：理查王万岁，英国的尊君万岁！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 阿门。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 明天就请举行加冕礼吧？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 您既已决意如此，就请您指定日期好了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就明天我们前来朝见：此刻我们满心喜悦，请告辞了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 来，我们还是去祈祷敬神。再见，贤弟；——再见，好友们。

chinese.text: 是谁走过来了！原来是我的孙女普兰塔琪纳特，她的好婶娘牵着她呢！我的天呀，她也怀着一片真心，逛到伦敦塔来了，是想去探视两位小王子哪。媳妇，碰得巧呵。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 上帝祝福两位夫人，愿您俩今天精神愉快！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿你同样得福，好妹子！你哪儿去？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 就是到伦敦塔；我猜想您两位也同样巴不得能看到两位好王子吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好妹子，谢谢；我们一同进去——
正好，卫队长来得巧。官长，请允许我动问一句，亲王好吗？我的小儿约克好吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 很好，我敬爱的王后。对不起，原谅我不能让你进去探望他们：国王严令禁止出入。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 国王！谁是国王？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我说的是护国公大人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿天公庇佑，莫让他称王！他难道把我母子之情从中割开吗？我是他们的母亲；谁能拦阻我？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我是他们的祖母；我也要看他们。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我是他们的婶娘，而情同生母；带我去看他们。我可以代你承罪，也可以冒险为你担起这个职务。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不，夫人，不行，我不能这样交卸责任；我立过誓，还请原谅。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如果我在一小时之后遇见各位夫人的话，我就该恭贺您约克老夫人福寿无疆，眼看两媳都先后称后了。
来吧，夫人，您得马上驾临西敏寺，要在那里加冕为理查王后呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呀！剪开我的胸带，让我这颗扣紧的心房好宽松一下，否则这样惊人的消息会叫我晕倒。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 恼火的消息！呵！可厌的新闻！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 振作起来，母亲，您怎么啦？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，道塞特！莫同我多话，快走开；死亡和毁灭都赶上你来了；叫我母亲，这个称号对你们子女不吉祥。你若想摆脱死亡，就渡海过去，投奔里士满，才逃得出这个地狱之门。走，走吧，快离开这个屠宰场，以免徒增死者的人数，就此让我在玛格莱特的诅咒下死去吧，我不要再当母亲或妻子，也不要再被视为英国的一个王后。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 夫人，你这个主见十分明智。
不可放过一时一刻；我要为你给我儿子去一信，叫他来途中相迎；切勿麻痹拖沓，以致误事。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，一股阴风播散着苦难！呵！我这可诅咒的肚腹，死亡的苗床，是你产出了一个残害世人的恶怪，他生就一副毒眼，谁也躲避不了他那致命的目光！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好了，夫人，去吧；我衔命而来，急如星火。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我受命而去，绝非所愿。呵！愿上帝使那只圆金箍变为火热的钢圈，把它戴上我的头额，灼烧我的脑浆。让我接受含毒的涂首膏油；我宁愿在人们尚未嚷出“天佑吾后”之前就先瞑目而逝！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 去，去吧，可怜的人，我并不羡慕你这种光荣；我是凭良心讲话，还惟愿你一切顺利。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 唉！你可知道？当我为圣君亨利送葬鸣哀的时候，我目前这个丈夫走向前来；双手染着我那天使般先夫的鲜血，几乎还未洗涤干净；呵！当我一眼瞥见了理查的脸，不由得我心中起誓发咒，说道，“你害得我青春守寡，坐待红颜老去，你该遭天罚！在你婚娶之后，愿悲哀紧系你的床头；谁若一时癫狂，错嫁了你，她因你活着而受到的磨难，比起你害死了我的亲夫而使我受到的苦痛，将更加沉重”。呵！可叹我言犹未了，而我这一颗妇人的痴心不料竟堕入了他那甜言蜜语的陷阱，因此我那内心的诅咒也只得由我独自承当，从那时起，我的眼帘未能有片刻安息；他终宵心魂不定，梦魇将我惊醒，在他枕边我没有一时半刻享受过黄金般的熟睡。加之，他因仇视我父华列克而恨我入骨，不久必然把我抛弃。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再会了，伤心人！听你诉苦我心中悲戚。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我也一样从心底为您哀泣。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再会吧！可怜你哀怨满怀地接受荣华！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再会，可怜你从此将辞去荣华！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你去里士满那里，愿你得福！
你去理查那里，愿天使照看你！
你去圣堂，愿圣念占领你的心！我去坟墓里，安宁将与我同宿！我阅尽了八十多年的伤心事，欢乐苦短，灾难苦多，我好比狂涛中的弱舟。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 且等一会儿，陪我回头一看伦敦塔。古老的石块呀，可怜我两个幼儿，为了遭人忌妒关进了你的四壁高垣，如此柔嫩，如此俊美的小王子，你当保姆未免太粗鲁，当游伴未免太森严，做摇床又未免太坚硬！还望你，多温存。我这里痴情含愁痛，谨向你告别了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
