chinese.text: 奏号声。理查盛服戴冕；勃金汉、凯茨比、侍童及余人等上。

groups.rationale: Exact source spans withheld pending boundary review; no generated replacement.

chinese.text: 大家站开些。勃金汉贤弟。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的贤明的主君！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 伸出你的手来。
由于你的高见和辅助，我理查王得以升此高座；可是朕享受荣华难道就不过一日之计吗，还是作长远打算而尽情欢庆哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 延续下去，永享荣华！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！勃金汉，让我来试探一下，且看你是否一枚真金币；小爱德华还在，你猜我要讲什么话？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 请讲呀，我的好主君。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嗳，勃金汉，我说我要当君王。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是呀，你已经是君王啦，我的天下闻名的主君。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哈！我当真是君王了吗？对，可是爱德华还活着呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 的确，尊贵的君王。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，多么恼人的结果哪！让爱德华活着当“的确尊贵的君王”！贤弟，你一向并不如此迟钝，要我直说吗？我要那私生子死；我还要把这件事马上办到。你怎么说啦？快讲，简单明了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 殿下要怎样就怎样好了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嘿，嘿！你简直是一块冰，你的好心肠也给冻住了；且说，我要他们死，你同意不同意？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 让我喘一口气，等一会儿，好大人，我还没有能对此作出决定；我马上就来给你禀复。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 国王发怒了；看哪，他把嘴唇咬得好紧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我宁可同铁石般头脑的傻瓜或轻浮的孩子们谈话，有些鼓起眼珠看透我心迹的人是要不得的。雄心的勃金汉竟而慎重起来了。侍童！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 陛下！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你可知道有谁喜爱金子，情愿立功暗杀一个人吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我倒知道有一个满怀不平的人，他自命不凡，恨自己过于穷困；金子对他抵得上二十个雄辩家，一定能买得他赴汤蹈火，不辞艰险。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他名叫什么？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 他叫提瑞尔，陛下。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我有些知道这个人，去喊他来。
深思熟虑而聪明过人的勃金汉，我再不能让他靠拢来参与计谋了。他长期以来不辞辛劳地支持我，难道现在想喘口气啦？好，让他去吧。
怎么啦，斯丹莱大人！有什么消息？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 有的，亲爱的君王，我听说，道塞特侯爵已逃到里士满那里去了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 走过来，凯茨比；放出消息去，说我妻安病重；我要把她关禁起来。去为我物色一个微贱的穷汉，马上把克莱伦斯的女儿嫁给他；那男孩是个傻子，我不怕他。看你在做梦哪！我再说一遍，放消息出去说王后安病了，可能会死。去干起来；这对我太重要啦，一切不利于我的火头都得扑灭。
我必须和我大哥的女儿结婚，否则我这王业就摇摇欲坠了。杀掉她两个兄弟，娶过她来！莫非是如意算盘！但是我已经流了这么多血，罪恶将会越陷越深；我横直是铁石心肠，再也流不出半滴眼泪了。
你就叫提瑞尔吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 詹姆士·提瑞尔，是您最忠实的仆役。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 是当真的吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 让事实来证明，我的好君王。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你敢下定决心为我杀一个友人吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 听您吩咐；可是我倒情愿杀两个仇人呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 嗯，倒是给你碰上了；两个死对头，他们扰乱我的心，不让我安睡，我要把他们交给你去对付了。提瑞尔，我是指那伦敦塔里的两个私生子。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 给我证件，让我明目张胆地去找到他们，我马上就会为你消除忧虑。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的话很中听。哈，站过来，提瑞尔；去，只消凭这个证件。起来，听仔细。（耳语）就是这些；专等你说声办妥了，我一定喜欢你，升你的职位。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.
Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我马上去办。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的君主，我心中已盘算过了，您刚才试探我的那个问题我想了一下。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好，不提那个。道塞特已投奔了里士满。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我听到了这个消息，我的君主。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 斯丹莱，里士满是你夫人的儿子；当心啰。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 陛下，我请您封赐，您有诺言在先，您的令誉和信义要维护，关键就在此；您所允许的海瑞福德伯爵爵位和那些动产都应该归我了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 斯丹莱，当心你的夫人，如果她传递了信息给里士满，你就得负责。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 陛下对我的正当请求怎么说？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我记得亨利六世曾预言里士满会当国王，那时里士满还不过是个顽皮的孩童。一国之王！也许——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的君主。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这个预言家为什么不趁我在旁就告诉我，说我会杀死他的呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 陛下，您答应我的伯爵爵位——

chinese.text: 里士满！上次我在爱克塞特，市长很客气给我看那儿的堡宅，说那堡宅叫作里士满。我听后吃了一惊，原来爱尔兰有一个歌者告诉过我，说我见到里士满就活不久了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的君主。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 唉，什么时间了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我大胆请陛下回忆一下您当初对我的诺言。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 唔，可是什么时间了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 正敲着十点钟。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好，让它敲吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为什么让它敲？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 因为一面你在乞求，一面我要默想，而你却像那钟里的小人一样叮叮当当敲个不停。我今天无心封赏。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就请决定一下您赏不赏我。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你真麻烦，我此刻心情不对头。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 竟有这样的事吗？就这样轻蔑地答谢我的功绩吗？我拥护他为君王就是为此吗？呵，我该想起海司丁斯来了，我的头颅难保，快投奔布勒克诺克去吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 一桩血腥的暴行已经完成；真是这片国土之上还未见过的一件罪大恶极的惨案。我曾唆使戴登和福列司特一起去硬着心肠下这毒手，可是他俩虽然是嗜血暴徒，听了那番临死前的悲诉，也竟顽石点头，像孩提一般流下热泪来。“看哪，”戴登说，“这幼嫩的孩子们躺在那儿；”“就这样，”福列司特说，“他俩这样相互抱住，白蜡似的纯洁臂膀缠得好紧；那嘴唇就像枝头的四瓣红玫瑰，娇滴滴地在夏季的馥郁中亲吻。枕边放着一本祈祷书；我险些儿，”福列司特说道，“心头软下来；然而那魔鬼呵，”——这个恶汉停住了；这时戴登又续道：“我们把开天辟地以来所未有的美品，天公的精心杰作，竟一手给闷死了。”他俩就这样受到良心的责备；话也说不出来，那时我们分了手，我便来向血腥的国王复命：他来了。
祝您万福，我的主君！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 好提瑞尔，你的消息是叫我高兴的吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如果我完成了您交下的使命就能叫您高兴的话，那就请您高兴吧，因为这件事已经办成了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你看见他们确已死了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 看见了，我的主君。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 埋葬了吗，好提瑞尔？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 伦敦塔中的牧师把他们埋了；至于埋在哪儿，怎样埋的，我却不知道。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 晚饭后到我这里来，提瑞尔，我要你告诉我他们死时的经过，同时不妨先想一想我该如何酬谢你，怎样满足你的欲望。再见，等你来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我敬向您告辞。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 克莱伦斯的儿子我已经关禁起来；他的女儿我已把她嫁给了穷人；爱德华的两个儿子睡进了亚伯拉罕的怀抱里
，我妻安辞别了人世。现在我知道布列塔尼的里士满
觊觎着我的侄女小伊利莎伯，想借这一结合，妄图争得王冠，我就去找她，再当个快乐幸福的求婚郎。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我的君主！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你这样闯进来，消息是好是坏哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 消息不好，我的君主，毛顿投奔里士满去了；勃金汉有坚强的威尔士人做后盾，上了战场，他的兵力正在增长。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 伊里和里士满才是我心上的刺，勃金汉和他那乌合之众不足为忧。好吧，我听说过，人若神经紧张，说东道西，就会犹疑不定，反把事情耽误了。耽误的结果是叫人丧志乞怜，寸步难移；我愿像天帝的神使或君王的令官那样振翅奋发！来，集合队伍检阅；决胜负，只要拿起枪矛；叛徒已冲上战场，我们不能再拖延了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 正是丰硕之果将熟，一口口被吞进那丑恶的死神之腹。我在这国境内偷生潜行，窥伺着仇人们凋零衰落。我亲眼见到了险恶的风云四起，如今且去法国，盼望着从隔岸挑起祸端，带来同样惨痛的黑暗终局。是谁来了？躲到一边去，潦倒的玛格莱特。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！我的可怜的王子们！呵，幼嫩的孩儿们，我的未放的花朵，新发的芬芳，如果你们的幼魂还在空中飘荡，还未投入永劫之路，愿你们的轻翅围绕我翱翔，且听你们的母亲在悲诉哀号。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 围绕她翱翔；是呀，因果报应已使这初升的朝阳沉入了衰老的黄昏。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这许多伤心事叫我哭哑了声腔，我悲啼过度，喉舌间再也发不出音调来了。爱德华·普兰塔琪纳特，你为什么死了？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 普兰塔琪纳特背叛了普兰塔琪纳特；爱德华为爱德华付偿了一条命。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，上帝！您怎能忍心抛开这样的羔羊，而由他们去遭受虎狼残害？您何时只顾沉眠，而让这种暴行得逞？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 正是亨利圣君和我可爱的儿子瞑目的时候。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 目无光，生无灵，可怜无常的人间鬼魂，一片惨景，世上的耻辱，墓中物篡夺了生命，悠久岁月的概略与综述，遍地泛滥着无辜鲜血，我愿在一块干净的国土上放下这颗放不下的心！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呀！这国土上既可让出一座多难的王座，为何不能设下一穴坟墓！也好让我藏身埋骨，免得在这地面停留。呀！还有谁能像我一样应该哀痛的呢？（在她身旁同坐。）

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 假如积年累月的忧伤值得最高的崇敬，就该尊老让坐；假如愁痛能接受愁痛作伴，也不妨先看我锁紧愁眉，听我诉衷肠。（与她俩同坐）你们尽可假我旧恨以历数你们的新愁。我有一个爱德华被一个理查杀害了，我有一个亨利被一个理查杀害了；你有一个爱德华被一个理查杀害了，你有一个理查也被一个理查杀害了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我也有一个理查，是你杀害了他；我还有一个鲁特兰，也是你同谋杀害了他。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你还有一个克莱伦斯被理查杀害了。从你那狗窝般的肚腹里爬出了一条地狱猛犬，来追噬我们大家。他张牙舞爪，扑住羔羊，撕咬，舐吮着他们宝贵的血，他把天工精品全都污损，又在人们哭肿的眼眶里肆虐，他是天地间一个了不起的大暴君，原是你放他出胎，来追逐我们进墓穴。上帝呵！你何等正直无私，我感谢你让这吃人兽来攫食同母所生的后嗣，还叫那老母与他人同声哀泣，共诉神明。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！亨利的妻后，我啼哭，你莫得意；上天知道，在你哀痛中我曾陪过眼泪。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 且为我设想；我渴待着洗雪旧恨，而且时到如今，我又看厌了满目疮痍。你那杀害我儿的爱德华已经死去；你另一个爱德华又抵偿了我儿的命；再赔上一个小约克，但他俩加在一起也抵不上我的重大损失。你的克莱伦斯曾刺杀过我的爱德华，如今他也死了；至于利佛斯、伏根、葛雷和荒淫的海司丁斯，都是这场惨变的旁观者，现在也都断送了性命，埋进了幽穴。理查仍留在人间，他是地狱的使者，专为魔鬼们收买灵魂，解送冥府；不过，快了，快了，他那无人怜悯的惨局已面临终结。眼见地面即将崩裂，地狱喷火，恶鬼呼号，圣徒祈祷，为了风驰电掣地传他上路。亲爱的上帝，撕毁他的命契吧！我但求能在瞑目之前说一声，“恶狗死矣。”

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！你曾预言过那一天我还会望你来助我咒骂这只毒胀的蜘蛛，这只驼背的蟾蜍。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我曾称你为我的幸运墙上所加的浮雕；称你为可怜的阴影，一个画中王后；你无非把我过去的声势来模仿；为一场大悲剧做了一些动听的剧情说明；哪怕你一时趾高气扬，终究要堕入尘埃；你枉做了一对伶俐的孩子的母亲；过去的一切都成了梦境、泡影、一块高贵的招牌、一面炫耀的旗帜，突兀招展着供人射击；一国之后做了笑柄，在舞台上不过串演着一个配角。如今你丈夫何在？你兄弟何在？你孩子何在？人生乐趣又何在？谁还来跪求你，高呼着“神佑吾后”？一向对你卑躬屈节的大臣们哪儿去了？追随你的大队人马又哪儿去了？前后对照就看清了你的处境：快乐的妻子成为最不幸的寡妇；幸福的母亲却在因为身为母亲而悲伤；坐听人诉的人反向人哭诉；国后变为愁眉蹙额的贱婢；从前轻慢我而今遭我轻慢；从前人人怕你，如今单怕一人；一向发号施令，如今无人听命。可见天道循环，赏罚分明，你只落得在时间的鹰爪下做个牺牲者；你倘若只顾怀念过去，同时又无法摆脱目前的处境，你的苦难将更难忍受。你既僭占了我的名位，岂能不分摊其中的苦楚？如今你的傲骨分挑着我的重担；我这里正好抽出我劳顿的肩头，把这全副担子都卸给你。再会吧，约克的夫人，厄运的王后；英国的这些忧伤，将在法国供我作笑料。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，你这诅咒的能手，且暂留一步，望你教我如何诅咒我的仇人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 夜间莫熟睡，白天要节食；把昨日的欢乐对照今日的忧伤；设想你的孩儿们比过去还可爱，设想他们的凶手比现在还狠毒；夸大损失，就更能衬托出祸首的凶残。这样反复思量，自然会教会你如何诅咒。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我辞不达意；呵！望你借给我利舌，以舔我的锋芒。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的忧痛就能磨炼你的字句，使得你锋牙利齿与我一样。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为什么灾难总叫人有话讲不完？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 辞令原是消除苦痛的辩护人，他们极吹嘘之能事，聊以自慰，可惜好景不长，枉留得悲恨的余音在空中颤动！可是还该让他们尽情发挥；虽然于事无补，却也好平一平心头气。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 果真如此，就不必默默无言；跟我去，运用我们的恶声，要去扼杀那个扼杀了你两个好孩子的畜生。喇叭响了，让我们齐声嚷起来吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 谁在拦阻我们的行列前进？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！是我，我早该从胎中就把你勒死，早该拦阻了你的生路，免得你这个恶种来人间屠宰生灵！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那只金冕岂能掩盖你的头额？如果正义得以伸张，那顶王冠上就该刻着一幅正统太子和我的儿子兄弟们惨遭杀害的画面。恶棍，要你交代出来，我的孩儿们在哪里？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 毒虫，恶魔，你三哥克莱伦斯哪里去了？他的小儿纳得·普兰塔琪纳特又在哪里？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 善良的利佛斯、伏根、葛雷在哪里？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 和善的海司丁斯在哪里？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 吹起来，喇叭！敲起来，鼙鼓！莫让众天听见这两个饶舌妇触犯天尊。敲奏起来，我说！
除非你们能克制自己，和颜悦色，否则我就发出隆隆的炮声把你们的叫嚷淹没得一字不闻。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你是不是我的儿子？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呀，感谢上帝，感谢父亲和你自己。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就容我讲我所容不下的话。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 老夫人，我却带着些儿您的性子，言语中有难听的调子我听了就受不住。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，等我来讲！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 讲吧；我可不会听。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我一定用和缓温柔的语调。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 还得简要，好母亲；我有要紧事呢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 如此紧急吗？上帝知道，我怀着满心痛苦已等你好久了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我不是终究来安慰您了吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呸，有十字架为凭，你很清楚，你来到人世间为我造成了人间地狱。你一出生，就让我背上了痛苦的重担；孩提时你暴躁倔强；入学后你更加凶狠粗野；血气方刚的时日你胆大妄为；成年后又变得骄横、险诈、恶毒，愈是和气你愈能伤人，你笑里藏刀；在你和我同处的岁月中，你何尝有过片刻给我任何安乐？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 的确没有，除非有一次邀请过您老人家一同用过早点。如果您看不惯我，就让我继续前进，免得惹您生恨，夫人。敲起鼓来！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我要你听我讲。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 您讲得太刺耳了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 再听我讲一句话；从此以后决不再同你讲话了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 哦！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 愿天公有眼，你在这一次战争中休想得胜，也不得生还；否则我宁可年迈心碎而死，而不愿再见到你的面。现在要你听取我最凶恶的咒诅，让你在交战之际感到心头沉重，重过你全身的铠甲！我要为你的敌方祈祷，向你攻击，让爱德华孩儿们的小灵魂在你敌人的耳边鼓噪，预祝他们成功，赋与他们胜利。你残杀成性，终究必遭残杀；生前有臭名作伴，臭名还伴随你死亡。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我虽更该咒骂你，但是力不从心：只好附和她，说一声阿门。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 等一下，夫人；我一定要同你讲一句话。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我已没有王室血统的子嗣好供你屠宰；若说起我的女儿们，理查呀，她们要去虔心修道，不再啼哭当君后了；所以，莫再想谋害她们的性命吧。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你有一个女儿名叫伊利莎伯，才貌双全，高贵而温雅贤淑。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 难道她就该因此而丧命吗？呵，饶了她吧，我尽可污损她的美德，破坏她的容颜；甚至诬蔑我自己对丈夫不贞洁，使女儿难以见人；但求能保全她的生命，不致遍体鳞伤，流血而死，我宁愿承认她不是爱德华的亲生女儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 莫污蔑她的身世；她是名门公主。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为了救她一命我宁可否认。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 她的生命全靠她的身世做保障。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 就是有了这层保障，她的两个兄弟才断送了性命。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵！想是他们出生时候星位不正！

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不对，是他们生后遇见了歹人残害。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 命运有定数，确难逃避。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 的确，假使让一个背弃了神恩的人操纵命运的话；神恩如果能赐给你一条比较美好的生命，我的孩儿们也不会如此惨死了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 听你这样讲，好像是说我杀害了我的侄儿们。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 侄儿们，真不错；可惜已被他们的叔父夺去了他们的权位、自由、生命、安乐和亲人。不论是谁下手戳穿了那柔嫩的心房，总是你的头脑在暗中布置了毒计；那杀人的刀口原很迟钝，只有在你的铁石心坎上磨过之后才能刺进我那羔羊的小腑脏。若不是忧痛驯服了我的心头恨，不提起孩儿们还罢，一提起来，我恨不得把指尖挖进你的眼眶，然而在这绝望的死海岸边，我好比一叶残破的船只，帆索全废，撞上你这深礁暗石，落得个粉身碎骨。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 夫人，我还殷切期望着在这场血战之中赢得千钧一发的功绩，即或你和你一家人曾经受到我的伤害，我却愿意给你加倍的补偿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 天颜冷酷，哪里还会有什么隐匿的福分落得我来享受半分？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的孩子还会腾达呢，高贵的夫人。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 腾达到绞台上去，去牺牲头颅吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 飞黄腾达，荣华富贵，不含糊，登上世间至尊的帝王之位。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你只顾信口雌黄来耻笑我的悲痛；且说给我听，你能有什么尊荣，什么显位，来加诸我孩儿之身？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我所有的一切；呀，连我自己也在内，我愿全都交给你的一个孩子；好叫你把那些念念不忘、认定是我所一手造成的心头创痛，淹没在你愤怒心灵的忘河之中。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 少唠叨，否则怕你这套仁义的话还没有说完，而你那仁义之心早已消失了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就听我讲吧，我从心灵深处喜爱你的女儿。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我女儿的母亲要凭她的心灵来作出判断。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你作出怎样的判断呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你从心灵深处喜爱我的女儿，也曾经从你心灵深处喜爱过她的两个兄弟；我从我的心灵深处要向你道谢。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 莫这样急于曲解我的本意；我是说，我打心底里爱你的女儿，要把她立为英国王后。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那么，你说谁是她的国王主君呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 就是立她为王后的人，还有谁哪？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 什么！是你？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 就是我，你意下如何？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你怎么向她求婚呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 正是要向你请教，因为你最熟悉她的性情脾气。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你要向我请教吗？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 夫人，这是我的真心话。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 叫那个杀她两兄弟的凶手送给她两颗血淋淋的心；在心上印着爱德华和约克两个名字；可能她会哭泣，这时递给她一块手帕，正如当初玛格莱特递给你父亲一块染上鲁特兰的鲜血的手帕一样，告诉她，这手帕已浸透了她兄弟们的血，可以用来擦她的眼泪。如果这样还不足以赢得她的爱，就写一段你生平的丰功伟绩让她赞赏；告诉她你已杀害了她的叔父克莱伦斯，和她的舅父利佛斯；并且为了她，你还匆匆地处理了她的好婶娘安。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 夫人，你在讥讽我哪；这不是赢得你女儿的方法。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 并无其他方法，除非你能摇身一变，变成一个没有做出这些事的理查。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 姑且说我做了这些事，为的是爱她？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 不行，她见你以杀人流血的方法来换取爱情，岂不要一心恨你到底。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 要知道，凡事木已成舟便无法挽回；人们往往做事不加考虑，事后却有闲空去思索追悔。我如果的确夺取了你儿子的王位，我就还给你的女儿作为赔偿。如果我杀害了出自你胎中的后嗣，我要在你女儿身上繁茂你的血统，同时传下我的种；有爱孙称你为祖母和有爱子叫你一声慈母，并无丝毫差异；孙儿虽比儿子低了一辈，但他们还是离不开你的本性，是你的血裔；你一次产痛便儿孙满堂，虽然她不免要和你一样，通宵呻吟。你的儿女苦扰了你的青春，但我的子嗣将为你承欢晚年。你无非损失了一个为君王的儿子，可是因有这个损失，你的女儿却当了国后。我固然不能依我的心愿来抵偿你一切，只好请你接受我一副真诚。你的儿子道塞特现在正胆战心寒在异国流亡，心情难安定，可是一旦这良缘成为事实，就可马上召他回来，荣居高位，身受显职。国王既称你美貌的女儿为后，自当称你的道塞特为国弟，以至亲相待；你也成为一国君王的母后，你在苦难中所遭受的摧残，就将换来加倍的补偿，也还落得个心地安宁。哈！我们来日方长；你眼中所流过的点点伤心泪都将变成一颗颗闪耀的明珠，好比在快乐的市场上放债收利，本利相比，往往坐享对本，还加百成。去吧，我的岳母；找你的女儿去；用你的经验教她勿再害羞；让她做好准备，接纳一个情人的请求；把君王的金光火焰点燃她那颗柔嫩的心；让公主领会到婚后的欢乐将是一片甜蜜宁静的好时光。目前有勃金汉在作乱，他是个渺小笨拙的叛徒，且待我一鼓而把他歼灭，凯旋荣归，就好庆祝我英雄佳人结成良缘；新婚之夜我要向她历数战功，尊她为女中之雄，凯撒之凯撒。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 这叫我怎么讲才好？说她父亲的弟弟要做她的夫君吗？或干脆说，她的叔父？还是说，杀她兄弟和舅父的刽子手？我该用什么称呼去为你求婚哪？什么称呼才能本着神意、法律或是我的声誉和她的爱，去拨动她那少女的心弦呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 说这个结合有利于英国的和平。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 英国以不断的战争，自能换得和平。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 说那发号施令的君王在向她恳求。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 所恳求的事却为万王之王所不容。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 说她将被封为万人之上的王后。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 正像她母亲一样为这称号而哀哭。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 说我一定爱她，始终不渝。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 可是这个“始终”，究竟何始何终？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 在她美满的生命中永远芬芳。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 但她那芬芳的生命又美满得几时呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 与上天和自然同存。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 凭地狱和理查而定。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 说我以君王的身份供她使唤。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 但她以臣侍的身份不屑使用这君权。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 为我向她巧用你的辞令。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 老老实实最能打动人心。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就老老实实告诉她我这一片真情。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 老实而不真切，说起来倒很别扭。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的论断太肤浅，太随便。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 呵，不对！我的论断既深切，又沉着；可怜的小宝贝们已经深埋黄土，沉寂无声了。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 莫再弹旧调，夫人；逝者已矣。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我要一弹再弹，弹到心弦断。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 现在，让我凭圣乔治，我的爵勋和我的王冠——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 一是渎圣，二是玷辱，三是篡夺。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我发誓——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你一无所凭；算不得誓言。乔治被你亵渎，失去了他的圣名；爵勋被你玷辱，出卖了它的勋德；王冠被你篡夺，丧失了它的尊荣。如果你发誓立愿想取信于人，就得凭你所未加污损的事物为证。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就，凭人世间——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你的罪孽满人间。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 凭我父亲的丧亡——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你生来所作所为已经污辱了他的死亡。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就，凭我自身——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 你自身也被你糟蹋干净。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那就，凭上帝——

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 对上帝你所犯下的罪行最是严重。假如你知道戒惧，不敢违背神誓，你哥哥在位时所完成的团结就不致破坏，我兄弟也不致遭害而死。假如你知道戒惧，不敢违背神誓，此刻环绕你额前的帝王金圈早该在我儿的柔嫩的两鬓间闪耀了，并且至今他俩还活泼泼地呼吸在人间，可恨今天这两个埋在泥土中的幼弱的睡伴，竟由于你不顾恩义而供虫蚁侵蚀殆尽了。你还能凭什么立誓呢？

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 凭那未来的岁月。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 那未来已被你过去的罪恶污损了；我自己从今以后只有泪雨淋淋，要把你过去所留下的污渍洗涤干净。孩子们孤苦伶仃，乏人抚养，因为你残害了他们的父母，他们要哀哭到老年：父母们如老树枯萎，因为你屠宰了他们的子嗣，他们只落得白发苍苍悲日暮。切莫凭未来发誓；你过去已是胡作非为，在利用未来之前你已经糟蹋了未来。

groups.rationale: Automatic full-speech/turn mapping; original English blocks and Chinese source spans are preserved. Not a semantic editorial certification.

chinese.text: 我还希望昌达，也愿意悔罪，在胜负难定的敌我交锋之际，我祈求好运来临！我诅咒我自己！天意与幸运莫给我欢乐！白昼莫为我放光；黑夜莫给我安息！如果我不对你这位美貌的皇室公主献出真心的爱、洁白的虔诚和神圣的思念，我愿满天吉星都背我而行！有了她，我和你才有幸福安乐；没有她，就只得让死亡、荒芜、毁灭、凋零降落这国土，尾随着我和你，追踪着她自己和多少虔敬上帝的人；除非如此，这一切都难幸免；除非如此，这一切都不会幸免。所以，亲爱的岳母——我必须这样称呼你——务必为我传达此意；为我的未来多申诉，不必谈过去；力陈我来日的功绩，不必提我所应得的处分；说明当前的急务和大势，不可学孩童般不明大义。

chinese.text: 高贵的君王陛下，西边海岸行驶着一列强大的舰队；海滩头挤满了许多行踪不明的队伍，装备不整，也无心去击退那进犯的敌人。据揣测，那舰队的首领是里士满；他们在海面漂荡，专等勃金汉前去接应登陆。

chinese.text: 王座上没有人吗？王权不起作用了吗？国王死了吗？国家没有了主吗？除我之外，约克王室的后裔还有谁在？赫赫约克的皇嗣不当君王，谁当君王？既然如此，你且说来，他出海来干什么？

chinese.text: 再给我一匹马！把我的伤口包扎好！饶恕我，耶稣！且慢！莫非是场梦。呵，良心是个懦夫，你惊扰得我好苦！蓝色的微光。这正是死沉沉的午夜。寒冷的汗珠挂在我皮肉上发抖。怎么！我难道会怕我自己吗？旁边并无别人哪：理查爱理查；那就是说，我就是我。这儿有凶手在吗？没有。有，我就是；那就逃命吧。怎么！逃避我自己的手吗？大有道理，否则我要对自己报复。怎么！自己报复自己吗？呀！我爱我自己。有什么可爱的？为了我自己我曾经做过什么好事吗？呵！没有。呀！我其实恨我自己，因为我自己干下了可恨的罪行。我是个罪犯。不对，我在乱说了；我不是个罪犯。蠢东西，你自己还该讲自己好呀；蠢才，不要自以为是啦。我这颗良心伸出了千万条舌头，每条舌头提出了不同的申诉，每一申诉都指控我是个罪犯。犯的是伪誓罪，伪誓罪，罪大恶极；谋杀罪，残酷的谋杀罪，罪无可恕；种种罪行，大大小小，拥上公堂来，齐声嚷道，“有罪！有罪！”我只有绝望了。天下无人爱怜我了；我即便死去，也没有一个人会来同情我；当然，我自己都找不出一点值得我自己怜惜的东西，何况旁人呢？我似乎看到我所杀死的人们都来我帐中显灵；一个个威吓着明天要在我理查头上报仇。

chinese.text: 那就该是披甲发令的时间了。

亲爱的同胞们，时间已经十分紧迫，我无法和你们尽情多谈了；可是大家只消记住这一点，上帝和正义都在同我们一起作战；圣洁的圣徒们和冤死的人们都在为我们祈祷，他们站在我们面前像一座高耸的堡垒；除了理查而外，他手下的人没有一个不宁愿我们战胜，惟恐他得到胜利。要知道他们所跟从的这个人是个什么样的人呢？弟兄们，他确实是一个杀人如麻的暴君；他在人血中成长，靠流血起家；利用他原有的地位以扩展势力，屠宰他自己的谋士，过河拆桥；一颗卑劣的假宝石，空凭英国的王座来衬托出光芒，其实是装错了地位，满不相称；他始终与上帝为敌。你们既和上帝的敌人交战，做上帝的战士必得天道庇佑；如果你们挥着汗除恶歼暴，功成名遂之后，自可高枕无忧；如果你们为国家战胜公敌，国家自然会把肥甘犒赏你们；如果你们为保护妻孥的安全而战，你们的妻孥就会来迎接胜利者回家园；如果你们把儿女救出了虎口，你们的子孙就可在你们的晚年承欢报恩。所以，为上帝之名和这一切权益，举旗前进，凭自愿拔刀杀敌去吧。至于我，为了这英勇的一役要激战一场，甚至不惜寒土埋冷骨；但是我若幸而获胜，这胜利的果实要和你们每一个士卒共享。击鼓吹号吧，奋勇欢呼起来；上帝与圣乔治在此！里士满与胜利！

chinese.text: “诺福克，你这马贩儿，
不要太胆大，因为你的魔鬼头子已被人出卖。”
这是敌人耍的小把戏。走，将士们，担起各自的任务来。莫让喋喋的梦呓使我们丧胆；良心无非是懦夫们所用的一个名词，他们害怕强有力者，借它来做搪塞；铜筋铁骨是我们的良心，刀枪是我们的法令。向前进，奋勇作战，我们去冲锋陷阵；即便不能上天，也该手牵手进入地狱门。

说过的话我何必还来噜苏？只消记住对方是些何等人：不过是一群流氓、歹徒和逃犯，布列塔尼的渣滓，村夫贱卒，他们因地窄不能容，泛滥出去，一个个铤而走险，眼见他们要遭毁灭，而葬身无地。你们安眠，他们想来横加惊扰；你们拥有良田美妻，他们要来强行霸占，奸淫掳掠。是谁在率领他们呢？原来是一个微不足道的小子，他依靠着母后赒济，常年被收容在布列塔尼。他是一个黄口软骨头的家伙，生来从未经受过风霜。这是一堆浪迹海外的法国敝屣，不自量力；是一群乞食的饿莩，欲生不得；他们早已无路可寻，若不胆大妄为、另寻生路，这些可怜虫呀，就只有死路一条了；现在让我们来把他们鞭挞下海，扫一个干净吧；即便我们要被征服，来征服者也得像个人，而不是这班布列塔尼的私生野种；他们在本土上原已遭我祖先痛剿过、扫荡过，在历史上成为人所不齿的逆种。难道听他们这些人来蹂躏我们国土吗？来淫乱我们妻女吗？
听哪，他们的战鼓声！战吧，英国人！战吧，英勇的士兵们！挽起弓来，弓手们，搭上你们的箭！用力刺你们的壮马，杀出一条血路去；不怕枪矛断，要惊起天心的战云！

chinese.text: 按他们的身份依礼入葬；对逃亡的士兵宣布赦免令，让他们前来归顺；然后，我们既已向神明发过誓愿，从此红、白玫瑰要合为一家。两王室久结冤仇，有忤神意，愿天公今日转怒为喜，嘉许良盟！我这句话，纵有叛徒听见，谁能不说声阿门？我国人颠沛连年，国土上疮痍满目；兄弟阋墙，闯下流血惨祸，为父者在一怒之间杀死亲生之子，为子者也毫无顾忌，挥刀弑父；凡此种种使得约克与兰开斯特两王族彼此叛离，世代结下深仇，而今两家王室的正统后嗣，里士满与伊利莎伯，凭着神旨，互联姻缘；上帝呀，如蒙您恩许，愿我两人后裔永享太平，国泰民安，愿年兆丰登，昌盛无已！仁慈的主宰，求您莫让叛逆再度猖狂，而使残酷岁月又蹈覆辙，在我国土上血泪重流！愿您永远莫让叛国之徒分享民食！今日国内干戈息，和平再现；欢呼和平万岁，上帝赐万福！
